jobs.title: Project Coordinator - Operations
jobs.description:
The mission of Hope the Mission is to prevent, reduce and eliminate poverty, hunger, and homelessness by offering immediate assistance and long-term solutions.

**Position Purpose and Summary**

Every repair, vendor visit, permit renewal, and vehicle inspection at HTM begins as a request that someone has to receive, route, and follow through on until it is closed. The Operations Coordinator is that person.

Reporting to the Director of Operations, the Project Coordinator - Operations serves as the intake, dispatch, and coordination point for the Operations Department across Facilities and Maintenance, Safety, IT, Fleet Management, and Warehouse and Delivery Logistics. This role monitors and triages the MaintainX queue and assigns work to the appropriate staff member or approved vendor; maintains the departmental compliance calendar for licenses, permits, inspections, and fleet records; solicits quotes and issues purchase requests within assigned thresholds; reconciles vendor invoices; and compiles the reporting that department and senior leadership rely on. The Operations Coordinator supports both the Director of Operations and the Operations Manager.

Operations is a department where the cost of a dropped request is measured in a shelter without hot water or a van that cannot make a food run. The Operations Coordinator exists so that requests are not dropped, deadlines are not missed, and no repair, renewal, or inspection depends on someone remembering it. This is not clerical work performed in service of a department. It is the mechanism by which the department keeps its commitments.

**Responsibilities**

***Request Intake and Dispatch***

* Monitor the MaintainX queue and all Operations request channels throughout the workday. Log, categorize, and assign priority to every incoming request.
* Dispatch requests to the appropriate Facilities, Maintenance, Safety, IT, or Fleet staff member, or to an approved vendor, based on trade, site location, and urgency.
* Acknowledge every incoming request within the departmental 24-hour response standard. Confirm receipt to the requesting site and communicate an estimated response time.
* Redistribute open work when a staff member is unavailable or a site escalates. Notify the Director of Operations or Operations Leadership of any request that cannot be assigned within standard.
* Track open tickets through to closure. Follow up on aging work orders and escalate any request that exceeds the established resolution window.
* Recognize matters that require management judgment rather than routine routing, and escalate them promptly rather than resolving them independently.

***Vendor and Purchasing Coordination***

* Solicit and collect quotes from approved vendors. Assemble comparison documentation for the Director of Operations or Operations Manager where multiple quotes are required.
* Issue purchase requests and work orders to approved vendors within assigned dollar thresholds. Route any request exceeding the assigned threshold, or involving a vendor not on the approved list, to the Director of Operations for approval before any commitment is made.
* Schedule vendor site visits, service calls, and preventive maintenance appointments. Confirm site access and notify site leadership in advance.
* Maintain the vendor file including W-9s, certificates of insurance, business licenses, signed agreements, and contact records. Track expiration dates and request renewals before coverage or credentials lapse.
* Reconcile vendor invoices against work performed and approved quotes. Flag discrepancies to the Director of Operations before invoices are submitted for payment.

***Compliance Documentation and Tracking***

* Maintain the Operations compliance calendar covering facility licenses, permits, regulatory inspections, fire and life safety certifications, and DPH requirements. Issue advance notice of upcoming renewals and expirations.
* Assemble compliance documentation for audits, monitoring visits, and funder or regulatory requests.

***Reporting and Records***

* Maintain the departmental filing structure so that records are current, organized, complete, and retrievable.
* Prepare agendas, materials, and meeting notes for departmental meetings as directed.
* Provide status information to sites and internal departments on ticket status, repairs, and estimated response times.

***New Site Setup and Demobilization***

* Maintain the new site operational readiness checklist. Track the status of each item and report progress to the Director of Operations.
* Open and coordinate utility accounts, waste service, pest control, alarm monitoring, and recurring service contracts.
* Coordinate delivery and installation scheduling for furniture, equipment, and technology.
* Support demobilization logistics including account closure, equipment recovery, and record retention.

***Secondary Duties and Responsibilities***

* Provide administrative and scheduling support to the Director of Operations and the Operations Leadership.
* Maintain inventory of departmental supplies, keys, access credentials, and assigned equipment.
* Participate in departmental and organizational meetings, training, and committees as assigned.
* Additional tasks, projects, and responsibilities as assigned by the Director of Operations.
* This position requires occasional travel to multiple HTM locations. Travel percentage: 15%

**Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required. Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in business administration, operations management, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum two years of administrative, coordination, dispatch, or operations support experience required.
* Experience with work order or ticketing systems, vendor coordination, or compliance record keeping strongly preferred.
* Prior experience supporting a multi-site organization preferred.
* CalOSHA 10 Certification required; or ability to obtain within 90 days of hire.

**Skills**

**Role Purpose:**

The Paid Media Coordinator is a core support and execution-focused role within the Media team. The primary function is to assist the daily operational, tactical, and administrative requirements of media campaigns across content creators, endemic media, self-serve, auction-based platforms (primarily Google, and paid social). This position is responsible for ensuring the accurate setup, proper pacing, consistent monitoring, and quality assurance of campaign delivery, providing critical support to Senior Planners and Supervisors. This position is a three month contract with an opportunity to be transitioned to a full time role.

### **Core Functions and Responsibilities:**

The duties of this position are divided into four primary functional areas:

#### **1. Campaign Setup and Stewardship (40%)**

This function ensures the technical accuracy and continuous delivery of all live campaigns, as well as necessary administrative documentation.

* **Setup & QA:** Execute the complete technical setup of campaigns, including the accurate configuration of pixels, UTM tracking, creative uploads, ad creation, and trafficking for both Google, endemic media and paid social platforms.
* **Tracking Management:** Generate, compile, and QA all necessary UTM tracking links required for approved media plans.
* **Pacing & Delivery:** Conduct mandatory weekly (or as needed) checks on campaign pacing and delivery. Identify and proactively flag any under/over-delivery risks or budget discrepancies to the Supervisor/Planner.
* **Operational Coordination:** Liaise with Planners to maintain an updated tracking log of all pending materials (creative assets, ad copy, landing page URLs, client approval) required for campaign launch or maintenance.
* **Financial & Project System Support:** Assist the team with updating and maintaining internal financial tracking and project management systems to ensure accurate record-keeping of budgets, deliverables, and timelines.
* **Billing Support:** Assist the Media Planners/Director with monthly account reconciliation processes for media spend and documentation.
* **Data Contribution:** Gather and organize campaign performance data points to contribute to both internal performance reviews and external client reporting decks.

#### **2. Paid Social Execution Support (30%)**

This function supports the implementation and maintenance of biddable social campaigns.

* **Campaign Execution:** Implement and manage campaign settings and biddable formats across platforms (Meta, X, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit) to align with client goals (e.g., engagement, acquisition, awareness) as directed by the supervising Planner.
* **Audience Research:** Conduct and compile initial research on targeting parameters, audience segments, and competitor activity to support strategic planning phases.
* **Optimization Support:** Under supervision, perform routine campaign optimizations, including minor bid adjustments, budget shifts, and testing of new ad copy/creative within active campaigns.

#### **3. Influencer Execution Support (30%)**

This function supports the implementation and maintenance of influencer campaigns.

* **Identification & Outreach:** Assist in identifying, vetting, and coordinating outreach to relevant influencers and content creators based on audience demographics, brand alignment, and campaign goals.
* **Continued Communications:** Manage day-to-day communication with influencers and creator partners, including deliverable requirements, contracts, content timelines, posting schedules, tracking links, and campaign expectations.
* **Performance Review:** Monitor influencer campaign performance metrics, including reach, impressions, engagement, clicks, and conversions, flagging any significant deviations from campaign goals.

### **4. Media Technology & Growth**

* **MarTech Stack:** Maintain working knowledge of the internal technology stack required for campaign execution, including budget management systems, data visualization tools, and ad verification platforms.
* **Measurement & Tagging:** Support the team by executing and validating third-party tracking implementation, including **Google Campaign Manager 360 (GCM) tagging and reporting** functionality.
* **Professional Development:** Proactively pursue necessary platform certifications (e.g., Google Ads, Meta Blueprint) and attend internal training sessions to ensure skills remain current with rapidly evolving media technologies.
* **Process Improvement:** Participate in internal meetings to share observations on operational efficiencies and contribute to the refinement of campaign setup and QA protocols.

Requirements:

### **Required Skills and Experience**

* **Experience:** Entry-level or 1-2 years of professional experience in communications, digital media execution, operations, or a similar role.
* **Education:** Bachelor's Degree in Advertising or Marketing Communications related field.
* **Platform Proficiency:** Foundational working knowledge of key digital platforms, including Google Ads (Search/YouTube) and self-serve social platforms (Meta, TikTok, X, etc.) is a plus.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager (Los Angeles, CA)
jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------

Spin.AI is looking for a creative, organized, and results-driven **Field Marketing Manager** to lead and execute field marketing initiatives across our portfolio of brands, including Spin.AI, Revyz, and DoControl.

In this role, you'll own the planning and execution of high-impact events and field marketing programs, including major cybersecurity conferences, industry summits, trade shows, executive roundtables, customer gatherings, and regional experiences. You'll work closely with Marketing, Sales, executive leadership, and external partners to create memorable experiences that strengthen relationships, build brand awareness, and contribute to measurable pipeline growth.

We're looking for someone who combines **strong event management expertise with a strategic, business-minded approach to field marketing**. You should be comfortable managing every aspect of an event, from initial planning and budgeting to onsite execution and post-event follow-up, while understanding how each initiative supports broader marketing and revenue objectives.

This is a role with real ownership and autonomy. We value people who bring fresh ideas, take initiative, work independently, and find smarter ways to get things done.

### **What You'll Do:**

* Run a full annual calendar of 35+ events across the US, EMEA, APAC, Canada, and LATAM, ranging from major flagship conferences and regional shows to community meetups, executive dinners, and partner sessions, while stretching the budget by running events remotely through local partners and vendors.
* Own the planning, coordination, and execution of field marketing programs across Spin.AI, Revyz, and DoControl, including conferences, trade shows, industry summits, executive roundtables, regional events, and customer experiences.
* Manage end-to-end event logistics, including venues, sponsorships, vendors, contracts, budgets, registration, booth design, collateral, promotional materials, and onsite execution.
* Collaborate with Sales teams on target accounts, pre-event outreach, meeting scheduling, attendee engagement, and post-event follow-up.
* Work with Marketing to align field marketing initiatives with integrated campaigns, messaging, promotional strategies, and broader GTM priorities.
* Coordinate event marketing campaigns across email, social media, paid channels, partner communications, and other relevant platforms.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with event organizers, industry partners, vendors, customers, and internal stakeholders.
* Track event performance, including attendance, engagement, meetings generated, qualified opportunities, pipeline influence, and return on investment.
* Manage event budgets, negotiate contracts, optimize spending, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
* Identify new and creative opportunities to engage cybersecurity and technology audiences through meaningful, differentiated experiences.
* Leverage AI tools and AI-driven workflows to streamline event planning, research, reporting, data analysis, vendor management, and operational processes.
* Continuously evaluate event performance, gather feedback, and apply learnings to improve future programs.

### **Experience We're Looking For:**

* 10+ years of professional experience, including 3–5+ years owning B2B events end to end, from strategy, budget, and vendor selection through onsite execution and post-event pipeline follow-up, ideally within cybersecurity, SaaS, or enterprise technology.
* Hands-on experience setting up international events (EMEA, APAC, LATAM), including successfully running and supporting events remotely when you can’t be there in person, by working through local vendors, partners, and in-region teams across time zones.
* Proven success with innovative, out-of-the-box approaches that drive outsized results from modest budgets. You know how to make a scrappy activation, a creative partnership, or a small, well-targeted event punch well above its weight, and you have the numbers to show it.
* AI-first in how you work, not just AI-curious. You already use AI as a major multiplier on your own productivity, going well beyond chatting in a browser to building AI projects, custom workflows, and automations (e.g., Claude, Claude Cowork, ChatGPT) that handle research, planning, content, reporting, and follow-up. Be ready to walk us through how you’ve set it up.
* Proven experience managing conferences, trade shows, executive events, roundtables, and other B2B field marketing initiatives from concept through execution.
* Strong understanding of how field marketing supports brand awareness, customer engagement, sales enablement, demand generation, and pipeline development.
* Experience collaborating closely with Sales teams, marketing leadership, executive stakeholders, and external partners.
* Excellent organizational, project management, and multitasking skills, with the ability to manage multiple events, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously.
* Experience managing event budgets, negotiating vendor contracts, coordinating logistics, and overseeing onsite execution.
* Familiarity with CRM, marketing automation, event management, and project management platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar tools.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to evaluate event performance, report on results, and make data-informed recommendations.
* AI-native proficiency, with demonstrated experience using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Cowork, and other AI-enabled platforms to improve productivity, research, analysis, and execution.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong attention to detail and the ability to build positive working relationships.
* Comfortable working independently in a remote, fast-moving, collaborative environment.
* Willingness to travel for conferences, events, and onsite execution, including occasional evenings and weekends as needed.

**ROOFCORP of America, Inc.**

Sales Coordinator Commercial Roofing | Anaheim, California Full-time, on-site | Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM | No nights, no weekends

**ABOUT ROOFCORP OF AMERICA**

We have been repairing, restoring, and replacing commercial flat roofs since 1985. We specialize in TPO, built-up roofing, and silicone restoration for building owners and property managers across California, Oregon, Washington, and Alaska. We are a family-run company with more than 40 years in business and offices in Anaheim, Seattle, and Bogotá, Colombia. Many of our people have been with us for twenty years or more. We operate on a simple standard: do honest work, do it right, and take care of the customer. Quality here is personal, not a department.

**JOB OVERVIEW**

The Sales Coordinator is the hub of our Pacific Southwest sales operation. Our estimators are out on roofs and our sales team is in front of customers. You are the person who makes sure nothing behind them falls through the cracks: proposals go out on time, bids are submitted before the deadline, follow-ups actually happen, and customer records stay accurate. This is a visible role with real ownership. You will work directly with our Anaheim field team, our Sales Manager in Seattle, and our back office in Bogotá. If you are organized, you like deadlines, and you take pride in catching mistakes before anyone else does, you will do well here.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

- Log incoming leads, service calls, and bid invitations accurately, the same day they arrive. - Build proposals and roof condition reports from estimator field notes and photos, clean, professional, and error-free before they reach a customer.

- Track the bid board: due dates, addenda, plan-room submittals, and prequalification packets. - Schedule roof inspections and estimator appointments, coordinating routes so field time is used well.

- Follow up on open proposals on a set schedule and keep the pipeline current. - Maintain customer and project records: contacts, insurance certificates, W-9s, and vendor portal registrations.

- Produce a weekly pipeline and activity report for the Sales Manager.

**REQUIREMENTS**

- Two or more years in sales coordination, project administration, estimating support, or inside sales support.

- Construction, roofing, or another skilled trade is a strong plus, but we will train the right person. - Excellent written English. Your documents go directly to building owners and property managers.

- The ability to learn new software quickly.

- Genuine attention to detail. In this seat, a wrong address or a missed deadline costs real money.

- Reliable on-site attendance, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM.

- An associate's degree is preferred but not required. We value hands-on experience equally.

**PREFERRED**

- Bilingual English/Spanish. - Experience with CRM systems or construction bid platforms such as BuildingConnected, iSqFt, Procore, or PlanHub.

- Experience serving commercial property management customers.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

- $28.00 – $34.00 per hour, depending on experience. Candidates with commercial roofing, bid platform, or property management experience start at the upper end of the range.

- Paid sick leave. - Paid holidays.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Apply through Indeed with your resume. Please include a short note of a few sentences telling us why this role is a good fit for you. In this position, written communication matters, and we read every note. ROOFCORP of America, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act.

Pay: $28.00 - $34.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Work Location: In person

The Associate Sales Representative (ASR) is an entry-level, field-based role responsible for supporting customer engagement, account development, and patient access initiatives within Long Term Care (LTC) accounts across an assigned geography. Working closely with Long Term Care Account Managers, Reimbursement and Access partners, and cross-functional teams, the Associate Sales Representative develops relationships with healthcare providers, long term care pharmacies, nursing facilities, assisted living communities, and other key stakeholders.

The Associate Sales Representative serves as a developmental role designed to build foundational expertise in pharmaceutical sales, account management, reimbursement, patient access, and the Long Term Care marketplace. Through customer engagement, on-the-job learning, and mentorship, this role prepares individuals for future advancement within the commercial organization.

**Primary Responsibilities**

**Customer Engagement & Relationship Development**

* Build and maintain professional relationships with healthcare providers, advanced practice providers, LTC pharmacies, nursing home staff, and other customer stakeholders.

jobs.title: Certified Medical Assistant/Research Coordinator
jobs.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a compassionate, detail-oriented, and highly organized **Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) who is fluent in both English and Spanish and proficient in phlebotomy** to join our OB/GYN practice.

This dual-role position combines hands-on clinical support with clinical research coordination. The ideal candidate will be comfortable providing direct patient care, performing blood draws, collecting and processing specimens, coordinating clinical research visits, and maintaining accurate medical and research documentation.

The successful candidate must be able to communicate effectively with English- and Spanish-speaking patients while helping deliver high-quality women's healthcare and supporting clinical research initiatives.

Key ResponsibilitiesClinical & Medical Assistant Duties

* Room patients, obtain vital signs, and update medical histories, medications, and allergies.
* Perform venipuncture and blood draws accurately and safely.
* Collect, label, process, and prepare blood and other specimens for laboratory testing or research shipment.
* Prepare patients for examinations and assist providers with OB/GYN procedures as directed.
* Perform point-of-care testing and other authorized clinical tasks.
* Administer medications, injections, or vaccines when authorized and appropriately trained.
* Maintain exam rooms, clinical supplies, and laboratory equipment.
* Assist with scheduling, referrals, prescription requests, and patient follow-up.
* Maintain accurate electronic health records (EHR) and protect patient confidentiality.
* Provide clear communication and patient support in both English and Spanish.

Clinical Research Coordinator Duties

* Coordinate clinical research activities under the direction of the Principal Investigator (PI).
* Assist with participant recruitment, prescreening, eligibility verification, and enrollment according to approved study protocols.
* Schedule research visits, procedures, specimen collections, and follow-up appointments.
* Obtain informed consent only when appropriately trained, delegated, and authorized.
* Collect, process, document, and track research specimens according to study requirements.
* Maintain accurate study records, source documentation, case report forms, and electronic data entry.
* Track study milestones, participant visits, and follow-up activities.
* Assist with regulatory documentation, study binders, training records, and protocol amendments.
* Communicate with investigators, sponsors, laboratories, and research participants as appropriate.
* Support monitoring visits, audits, and quality assurance activities.
* Promptly report protocol deviations, adverse events, and other reportable issues to the appropriate research leadership.

Required Qualifications

* Current Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) credential or another employer-approved medical assistant certification.
* **Fluency in both Spanish and English, with the ability to communicate effectively with patients in both languages.**
* Demonstrated competency and experience in phlebotomy and venipuncture.
* Experience in a physician's office, outpatient clinic, laboratory, or comparable healthcare setting.
* Knowledge of patient confidentiality, HIPAA, infection prevention, and specimen handling.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and accurate documentation practices.
* Proficiency with electronic health records and basic computer applications.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and time-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining patient safety and research data quality.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in OB/GYN, women's health, fertility, maternal health, or reproductive medicine.
* Previous clinical research coordination or clinical trial experience.
* Familiarity with Good Clinical Practice (GCP), informed consent, and human-subject protection requirements.
* Experience with electronic data capture (EDC) platforms and clinical research management systems.
* Knowledge of FDA-regulated clinical research and Institutional Review Board (IRB) requirements.
* Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification, if required by the practice.

Key Competencies

* Compassionate, patient-centered care.
* Strong phlebotomy and specimen collection skills.
* Fluency in Spanish and English.
* Exceptional attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Professional communication and discretion.
* Effective time management and multitasking.
* Commitment to research integrity, regulatory compliance, and patient safety.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively.

Work Environment

This position is based in an outpatient OB/GYN clinic and involves direct patient contact, blood collection, specimen processing, clinical procedures, and research-related administrative responsibilities. The employee must be comfortable working with sensitive patient information and supporting women's health research.

Compensation & Benefits

**Compensation will be determined based on the candidate's experience, qualifications, clinical skills, phlebotomy competency, and relevant clinical research background.**

Benefits may include:

* Paid time off and holidays, according to clinic policy.
* Health insurance and other benefits, if offered.
* Continuing education and professional development opportunities.
* Opportunities to expand expertise in women's health and clinical research.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit a resume highlighting their medical assisting experience, phlebotomy skills, Spanish/English bilingual proficiency, and any clinical research experience.

**Join our team and make a difference in women's healthcare by providing exceptional patient care and supporting research that advances women's health.**

Pay: From $16.90 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
GENERAL POSITION SUMMARY:

We are looking for a Content & Community Manager to own and execute social media, community engagement, and marketing content for our game titles. This role requires someone who understands gaming culture, can create and edit compelling content, and build strong relationships with our fan community.

This is a **highly** **hands-on and** **independent role**, ideal for someone comfortable managing multiple content channels and community platforms in collaboration with the Marketing & PR Manager and internal teams.

Duties and Responsibilities:

**Core Responsibilities (Priorities)**

* **Content Creation & Editing:** Plan, craft, edit, and bring to life marketing content that resonates with fans, including social media posts, promotional clips, and trailer scripts. Ensure all content reflects the brand voice and game messaging.
* **Social Media Management:** Manage official social media accounts (Twitter/X, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, etc.), develop and maintain content calendar around game launches, track engagement metrics, and optimize content strategies.
* **Community Engagement:** Engage with fans across Discord, Reddit, and social channels, monitor sentiment, report insights to the marketing team, and support community events or livestreams.
* **Collaboration & Coordination:** Proactively coordinate with the Marketing & PR Manager, developers, and internal teams to gather assets and ensure cohesive content execution. Own day-to-day coordination and follow-up with external creators, agencies, and freelancers, including deliverables, timelines, assets, and approvals.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Support influencer collaborations (Marketing & PR Manager leads main strategy).
* Contribute ideas for improving engagement and content effectiveness.
* Assist with marketing campaigns by providing content and community insights.
* Create postmortem reports for major campaigns, analyzing performance metrics, audience engagement, and content effectiveness. Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve future campaigns.

Required Qualifications:

* 5+ years of experience in content marketing, social media, or community management.
* Strong writing, editing, and storytelling skills.
* Ability to craft scripts for trailers and short-form social content.
* Experience producing or editing social media videos.
* Deep understanding of gaming culture and online communities.
* Experience managing social media accounts professionally.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience managing gaming communities, Discord servers, or forums.
* Experience with livestreams planning/execution and familiarity with Twitch, Youtube, OBS, or multistream workflows or content creator collaborations.
* Knowledge of JRPGs or Japanese games.

Other Requirements:

* Supervisory Responsibilities: No

Key Attributes:

Candidate should demonstrate these skills

* Highly creative and proactive
* Comfortable engaging directly with fans
* Strong content creation and editing skills
* Strong time management and organizational skills
* Team-oriented and collaborative

WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

* Work is typically performed either in an office environment with a moderate noise level or at your home.
* While performing the duties of this position, the employee is required to frequently sit and occasionally must stand, walk, use hands and fingers, and may lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.
* Specific vision abilities include the ability to read and analyze data in hard copy and on a computer screen, measure, or identify using eyesight and adjust vision focus.
* Abilities to communicate verbally and in writing to individuals and groups.

Compensation & Benefits:

* Benefits: Health, Dental & Vision coverage, 401k plan

Health care: effective first of the month following 30 days waiting period.  
401K: Require 3 months of service to be eligible.

* Paid holidays; 88 hours of vacation first year; 56 hours sick leave per year

**INNOCEAN USA**, a full-service ad agency located in sunny Huntington Beach, CA, is seeking a **Social Media Specialist** to join our **Kia** team!

We are a hybrid work environment, currently x3 days week onsite. Candidates must be local to SoCal.

**OVERVIEW**

The **Social Media Specialist** **[aka Sr Community Manager]** will support social content planning, platform strategy, creator evaluation, customer care, and performance reporting. This role connects strategy with day-to-day execution, translating audience insights, cultural trends, and performance data into clear recommendations and organized content plans.

The ideal candidate combines strong project management and attention to detail with strategic thinking, platform fluency, and an understanding of what makes content relevant to audiences.

**RESPONSIBILTIES**

**Content Planning & Partner Coordination**

* Own the development and maintenance of social content calendar briefs, calendar decks, and campaign posting decks, ensuring alignment with approved strategy, messaging, and platform best practices.
* Develop partner agency deck templates that clearly communicate strategic direction, content requirements, and delivery expectations.
* Serve as the primary contact for partner agency content delivery, managing timelines, consolidating feedback, and coordinating asset handoffs.
* Maintain accurate posting details, asset versions, and approval status across deliverables.

* Pull, organize, and validate performance data for monthly metrics deep dives and ad-hoc reporting.

* Experience coordinating internal teams, external partners, and multiple deliverables against deadlines.

* Strong writing, editing, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.

**BENEFITS**

* Wellness reimbursement program
* Company paid short- and long-term disability, and basic life

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

**Payrate:** ~$28~35.55/h DOE

**Contract Period:** 1 year

**Work location:** Santa Ana, CA

**Work Hours**: Monday – Friday , 8:30 AM~5:30 PM

 **Job Description**

**1. Position Overview**

The Mobile Business Unit supports the global distribution of mobile devices with a focus on speed, reliability, and operational efficiency. The Logistics Coordinator (Air & Ocean Operations) is responsible for planning, executing, and continuously improving inbound and outbound air and ocean freight operations, ensuring shipments move efficiently from manufacturers to warehouses and ultimately to customers.

This position requires hands-on experience in Air or Ocean Freight Operations, along with solid ocean freight knowledge. As our operation supports global transportation across multiple time zones, this position follows a five-day work schedule that includes weekend shifts based on operational requirements.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

1) Planning & Scheduling

* Create and maintain daily tracking reports for Air Export, Ocean Import and OTR including weekend operations

2) Port & Terminal Coordination

* Gather departure information for containers and air cargo at ports, terminals, and airports.
* Monitor and confirm on-time departures from U.S. Ocean terminals and major airports.
* Coordinate terminal departure schedules with terminal operators and customs brokers.

3) Movement Monitoring

* Track ocean containers, rail intermodal units, and air shipments in real time.
* Validate Import of Documentation (IOD) and Proof of Delivery (POD) on a daily basis.
* Respond promptly to shipment exceptions requiring immediate attention (e.g., delays, damages, customs hold).

4) Transload Warehouse Management

* Oversee Transload Warehouse (TW) capacity planning and utilization.
* Manage Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for transload operations (e.g., dwell time, on-time transload, damage rate).
* Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks and work with warehouse teams to implement corrective actions.

5) TL OB OTR Dispatch Management

* Schedule and dispatch Truckload (TL) Outbound (OB) orders using the Transportation Management System (TMS).
* Optimize routing and load consolidation to meet service-level agreements while minimizing transportation costs.

6) Partner & Stakeholder Communication

* Serve as the primary point of contact for logistics partners, including carriers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, internal supply chain teams, and customers.
* Handle claims, documentation, and issue escalations through phone, email, or virtual meetings.

7) Compliance & Documentation

* Ensure all shipments comply with international trade regulations, hazardous material requirements, and security standards.
* Maintain accurate records for audits and regulatory inspections.
* Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

8) Core Competencies

* Analytical Thinking: Translate large data sets into actionable insights.
* Problem Solving: Quickly identify root causes of operational issues and implement effective solutions.
* Communication: Communicate clearly and effectively with internal teams and external partners.
* Multitasking: Manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
* Ability to Work Under Pressure: Perform effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

 **Qualifications**

1) Education

* Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.

2) Experience

* Minimum 6 years of experience in logistics coordination, with a strong focus on international air and ocean freight operations.
* Hands-on experience in international Air, Ocean, and OTR freight forwarding operations is required
* Proven experience managing transload warehouse operations and Truckload (TL) dispatch.

3) Industry Knowledge

* Strong understanding of international air and ocean freight regulations, and customs procedures

4) Technical Skills

* Proficiency with ERP and logistics systems (SAP, TMS, WMS or equivalent).
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP.

5) Language

* English

6) Weekend work may be required.

 **Additional Information**

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Global Account Manager
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews.

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures.

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people.

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

We're hiring our first Global Account Managers to own and aggressively grow a small number of our largest global accounts — companies like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Meta, and Salesforce.

Accounts of this scale are not one company; they're dozens. Amazon alone runs research across retail, devices, AWS, advertising, and entertainment, in a dozen countries, with separate budgets and separate buying centers in each. We're already inside these organizations and the teams who use us love us. What we don't yet have is someone whose entire job is to turn a strong foothold into an enterprise-wide standard. That's this role.

This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the VP of Sales. You'll carry full commercial ownership of your accounts — expansion, cross-sell, pricing, and renewal — and an aggressive seven-figure growth target against them. You will not be working a wide territory or chasing net-new logos. You'll be going deep in a handful of the most important companies in the world, finding net new buying centers and getting introduced via referrals, building the relationships and the multi-year plan that make Outset the way they understand their customers.

You'll do it with a team around you. Each global account is supported by a dedicated account team — Sales Development, Research Operations, an Account Director, and a Solutions Consultant, with executive sponsorship from our leadership team. You set the strategy and direct the effort; the resources are there to execute it.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own a portfolio of a small number of strategic global accounts — companies on the scale of Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Meta, and Salesforce — with full commercial responsibility for expansion, cross-sell, pricing, and renewal.
* Find new buying centers, both regionally and within the larger umbrella brand, to pursue, predominantly via deep account understanding, referrals and in-person visits.
* Carry and exceed an aggressive seven-figure growth target across that portfolio.
* Build and maintain a live global account plan for each logo: every buying center by business unit, region, and research function; whitespace and spend map; executive relationship map; competitive position; and a dated path to each expansion.
* Multi-thread relentlessly — from practicing researchers to VPs to the C-suite — and build senior relationships durable enough to survive champion turnover, reorgs, and procurement cycles.
* Direct the extended account team (Sales Development, Research Operations, Account Director, Solutions Consultant, Marketing, and executive sponsors), setting priorities and holding the plan together across functions and time zones.
* Run executive business reviews that reframe the relationship around business outcomes, not usage stats, and convert them into committed budgets.
* Negotiate and close complex enterprise agreements — global MSAs, enterprise-wide and multi-region commitments, multi-year structures, enterprise procurement, security and privacy review — in partnership with Legal, Finance, and leadership.
* Coordinate coverage globally, aligning our regional teams behind a single account strategy rather than a set of local ones.
* Forecast with precision and keep a clean, current view of your accounts in Salesforce.
* Bring the voice of your accounts back into Outset — informing product direction, pricing, and how we build the global account motion itself.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 10+ years in enterprise sales, including 5+ years in a named global or strategic account role (Global Account Manager, Global Account Director, Strategic Account Manager, or equivalent) owning a small book of major brands.
* Direct experience selling into and growing accounts of this profile — large, global, matrixed technology or consumer organizations with many buying centers, such as Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Meta, or Salesforce.
* A proven record of exceeding aggressive seven-figure growth targets *inside existing accounts* — expansion, cross-sell, and renewal — not only net-new logo attainment.
* World-class relationship management. You are known for the depth and durability of the relationships you build, and you can point to accounts you grew over years, not quarters.
* Executive presence and commercial sharpness: credible with CxO and VP-level buyers, consultative enough to teach and shape their thinking, and comfortable negotiating at scale.
* Demonstrated ability to lead an extended, cross-functional account team without direct authority — you make the people around you more effective on your accounts.
* Experience navigating complex global commercial structures: multi-region contracting, enterprise procurement, multi-year commitments, and competing internal stakeholders.
* Operational rigor — a real account planning methodology, accurate forecasting, and CRM discipline.
* High ownership, opinionated, proactive, and comfortable with a very fast pace of both decision-making and execution in a startup that is still building the playbook.

jobs.description:
**Who we're looking for**

We're looking for a Revenue Operations Process Manager to shape how our go-to-market engine actually works.

In this role, you'll own the business processes, governance, and operating framework that powers our upper-funnel revenue engine. processes within our ABM tool 6sense. Your focus isn't on configuring the system; it's on defining how work should flow across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success, so everything operates as one cohesive system. You will define how target accounts are identified, prioritized, routed, engaged, and progressed through the buyer journey using 6sense as a core component of our operating model.

You'll act as the bridge between business and technical teams, translating GTM strategy into clear, scalable process logic and requirements.

This is a process architecture role, not a systems administration role. Success isn't measured by tickets closed or configurations shipped; it is measured by clarity, scalability, adoption, and performance.

Your focus is not system administration or campaign execution. Instead, you'll design the business logic, workflows, decision frameworks, and governance that ensure our account-based strategy translates into consistent execution.

**What You Will Own**

**Design End to End GTM processes**

* Build and evolve workflows across Marketing, SDR, Sales, and Customer Success
* Ensure inbound, outbound, and account-based motions work together as a unified system
* Define lifecycle stages, ownership models, and clean handoffs across teams
* Design how target accounts move from identification through engagement, opportunity creation, and pipeline progression
* Establish account stages, buying stages, ownership models, and engagement plays
* Ensure inbound, outbound, and ABM motions operate as a coordinated system rather than independent workflows

**Translate Strategy into Execution**

* Translate GTM strategy into:
  + Process flows
  + Decision logic
  + Business requirements
  + Acceptance criteria
* Partner closely with CRM and Systems teams, acting as the primary interface with GTM stakeholders
* Ensure implementations reflect business intent (not just technical feasibility)

**Own Process Governance & Data Clarity**

* Define and enforce:
  + Source-of-truth definitions
  + Data ownership models
  + Process standards across systems
* Create clear, human-readable documentation so teams understand how things work

**Define routing, prioritization, and signals**

* Design lead, account, and opportunity routing strategies
* Build prioritization frameworks based on segmentation and signals
* Eliminate gaps, duplication, and conflicting engagement paths

**Why Mintlify?**
=================

We're on a mission to empower builders.

* **Massive reach:** Our docs platform serves 100 million+ developers every year and powers documentation for 20,000+ companies, including Anthropic, Microsoft, PayPal, Spotify, Coinbase, X, and over 20% of the last YC batch.
* **Small team, huge impact:** We recently passed 65 employees and raised a $45 million Series B led by A16Z and Salesforce Ventures. Each new hire has a huge impact on shaping the company's trajectory.
* **Culture of** **slope over y-intercept****:** We value learning velocity, grit, and unapologetically unique personalities.

We grew in value faster than headcount and we’re looking to align the two quickly.

**What you'll work on here**
============================

You'll own targeted outbound into Enterprise and Strategic accounts. You'll research each account, find the right Director+ technical buyers, and reach them by email, phone, and LinkedIn. Your goal is booking meetings that our AEs turn into qualified opportunities.

* **Research:** Dig into an account before you reach out: their docs, their developer platform, how well AI agents can read their docs today, and who owns them.
* **Outreach:** Write messages that speak credibly to Director+ technical buyers. Personalize every touch to the account and the person.
* **Calling:** Calls are part of the mix, alongside email and LinkedIn. You're calling people you've researched, not dialing down a list all day.
* **Events:** Invite the right prospects to AE-hosted dinners and events, and make sure they show up.

**What you bring to the table**
===============================

* Incredibly fast learner - either with experience prospecting into engineering teams, or an ability to learn quickly
* Curiosity and the drive to show up, ask questions, work hard, and ride the highs and the lows. Absolutely non-negotiable
* Willingness to leverage AI powered technology to create efficiencies in your day to day cadence
* Ability to communicate credibly with technical buyers. You can hold a conversation with a Director or VP of Engineering about developer experience, documentation workflows, API strategy, and how AI agents read docs, without sounding like you're reading a script
* Strong written communication. Outreach reads like it was written by a thoughtful person, not a sequence tool. You personalize every touch for critical personas and accounts
* Research depth. You can look at an account and quickly understand why they're a fit, who the right contacts are, and what pain to lead with.
* Organizational discipline. CRM hygiene, clean handoff notes, systematic follow-up. You don't let things fall through the cracks.
* Appropriate Persistence. You know the difference between following up and spamming.
* Salesforce proficiency, outbound tooling including Nooks, Lemlist, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and others.

**Bonus Points****:**
=====================

* Prior SDR/BDR experience in B2B SaaS - particularly having sold to technical buyers or developer-focused companies
* Experience with event-based or dinner-based sales motions
* Background at a PLG or developer-tools company (you understand how product-led and sales-led motions coexist)

**Why you should join our sales team**
======================================

You'll be joining a company where the product sells itself to developers. Your job is instrumental in helping us bring Mintlify to the enterprise buyers who can deploy it at scale. The product-market fit is real. What we're building now is the sales motion to match.  
This is a ground-floor opportunity to build something. You won't be plugging into a mature SDR org with a playbook someone else wrote. You'll be writing the playbook and we'll be here to help you nail it.  
  
**Your path to AE**  
We hire SDRs to grow into AEs. You'll learn how enterprise deals get built from the first touch, and as you prove yourself, you'll move toward running deals of your own.

**Company Benefits:**
=====================

* Competitive compensation and equity
* 20 days paid time off every year
* 401k with Employer Match
* monthly wellness stipend
* 100% employee coverage for Health, Dental, Vision
* Commute stipend to help get you to and from work
* Free lunch and dinners
* Annual team offsite (previously went to Alaska, Hawaii, Jackson Hole)

Compensation Range: $80K - $115K

**Who We Are:**  
The Fund for Public Health in New York City (FPHNYC) is a 501(c)3 non-profit organization that is dedicated to the advancement of the health and well-being of all New Yorkers. To this end, in partnership with the New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH), FPHNYC incubates innovative public health initiatives implemented by DOHMH to advance community health throughout the city. It facilitates partnerships, often new and unconventional, between government and the private sector to develop, test, and launch new initiatives. These collaborations speed the execution of demonstration projects, effect expansion of successful pilot programs, and support rapid implementation to meet the public health needs of individuals, families, and communities across New York City.
  
  
**Our Culture:**  
We embrace a culture of learning, collaboration, innovation, and well-being, where open communication drives our impact.

The Bureau of Alcohol and Drug Use is seeking a Program Coordinator to support the Relay Initiative to coordinate staff schedules across 17 contracted hospitals, track program materials needed to support Wellness Advocate staff to engage participants, and support ongoing staff recruitment efforts. This involves collaborating with staff members to ensure there is staff coverage at hospital sites, utilizing a scheduling system to publish accurate schedules for staff reference, and monitoring an inventory system to ensure adequate program materials are accessible to staff to support their work.

Relay, a nonfatal overdose response system, is an initiative providing 24/7 support to individuals transported to hospital emergency departments (EDs) following a non-fatal opioid overdose. A Wellness Advocate will visit patients in the ED to provide immediate support and overdose prevention training following an overdose event and offer ongoing support and linkage to care for a maximum of three months after hospital discharge.

Reporting to the Program Manager, the Program Coordinator will be responsible for the following:
  

* Coordinate the program’s resources provided to the community, including naloxone, harm reduction and overdose prevention materials; and regularly track, re-order, assemble, and distribute the program resources.
* Coordinate staff recruitment efforts with community-based organizations, including harm reduction organizations such as Syringe Service Programs, peer training programs, as well as FPHNY. Manage the screening and hiring process for all incoming Relay staff. Screen resumes of Wellness Advocates, keep track of qualified candidates, conduct phone and in-person interviews, and check references of candidates.
* Coordinate and implement daily and monthly hospital coverage for Relay and ensure it is reflected in relevant automated systems.
* Create daily coverage schedules for distribution that includes the staffing plan for full time Relay Wellness Advocates, part time Relay Wellness Advocates, Supervisors, and Dispatchers.
* Communicate coverage changes to all staff as they occur. Troubleshoot any daily coverage changes or staffing needs by working with the supervisors and Program Manager.
* Plan the monthly staffing coverage in collaboration with the Program Manager and Program Assistant. Use staff availability responses to troubleshoot any overnight/weekend coverage changes and needs throughout the month, working to fill those needs with the guidance of the Program Manager using the existing workflow
* Communicate in a timely manner with team members for their scheduling needs by monitoring the non-human email account, Relay Coverage, for same-day callouts, scheduling conflicts, and planned time off.
* Represent Relay in intra-Bureau and Divisional workgroups and meetings and liaise and present to community coalitions
* Other duties as assigned to support the overall goals and mission of the department/ organization.

**Requirements:**  

* Be able to work independently, have excellent oral and written communication and organizational skills, and be a flexible team player. The candidate will also be detail- oriented with outstanding organizational skills
* Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced, high-volume environment, with high-level competence in Excel, Outlook, Forms, Word, and PowerPoint
* Knowledge of substance use, harm reduction, and drug treatment resources
* Sensitive to diverse ethnic, racial, and cultural backgrounds, gender identities, sexual orientations, communication styles, and socioeconomic conditions. Committed to ensuring that all people who use drugs have an equal opportunity to achieve their full health potential
* Physical Requirements: To manage program inventory: an ability to lift up to 20 pounds of program materials into a cart or onto a shelf. Reasonable accommodations will be made for qualified individuals with disabilities.

Administrative Coordinator - LaGuardia CARES

**POSITION DETAILS**

Founded in 1971 in Long Island City, Queens **,** LaGuardia Community College is one of seven community colleges of the City University of New York (CUNY). LaGuardia offers more than sixty associate degree programs and more than fifty workforce training, ESOL, GED, and pre-college programs. In 2023, LaGuardia served approximately 24,000 students. More than one-third of LaGuardia’s degree-seeking students are born outside the United States; they come from 136 countries and speak 43 heritage languages. Sixty percent are first-generation college students.

Virtually all LaGuardia students are ethnic minorities (89 percent), 58 percent are women, 27 percent are over the age of 25. Forty-six percent of associate degree students are Hispanic. Upon graduation most students transfer to four-year colleges, typically in CUNY, to complete their baccalaureate degrees. Graduates of career programs such as Nursing, Computer Technology, and Veterinary Technology enter the workforce. Kabrita is hiring a hands-on Key Account Manager to lead our natural, specialty and grocery business in the U.S. and our partnerships with UNFI and KeHE. Part of Ausnutria, a global leader in dairy nutrition with over a century of expertise, Kabrita makes gentle, goat milk-based formula and foods in the Netherlands under strict European safety standards. We serve more than 60 countries and feed 1.2 million babies a day, because we believe every family deserves a confident start.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the sales plan, trade budget and account contribution for all natural, specialty and grocery accounts, with clear action plans to recover and grow the business.
* Proactively define corrective measures when campaigns and promotions do not deliver against plan.
* Build joint business plans with key retailers and deepen relationships with buyers and category managers.
* Lead new distribution in conventional grocery, from national chains to regional banners.
* Manage the UNFI and KeHE relationships, including distribution, promotional programs and service levels, and control billbacks, chargebacks and deductions in partnership with Finance.
* Plan the promotional calendar across retailer and distributor programs, and evaluate every promotion on ROI, velocity and trade-spend efficiency.
* Use SPINS and Circana insights to influence assortment, shelf placement and pricing.
* Direct our broker partners, setting priorities, performance measures and a regular review cadence, and ensure in-store execution, including new item setup, planogram compliance and out-of-stock resolution.
* Lead, coach and develop our Account Manager, building account management capability across the U.S. team.

* Experience directing broker partners, and coaching or managing account managers.
* A hands-on mindset: comfortable doing the work yourself and being on the ground with customers and brokers.
* Leadership potential and the ambition to grow into a broader Retail Sales leadership role.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and presentation skills; you thrive with autonomy in a small team.
* Infant formula, baby nutrition or another regulated baby category experience is strongly preferred.
* Ability to work from our Hoboken, NJ office three days per week.

**What We Offer**

Kabrita pays 100% of the premiums for our employee benefits, for you and your family, so you can focus on the work and not on the cost.

jobs.title: Global Account Manager
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews.

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures.

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people.

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

We're hiring our first Global Account Managers to own and aggressively grow a small number of our largest global accounts — companies like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Meta, and Salesforce.

Accounts of this scale are not one company; they're dozens. Amazon alone runs research across retail, devices, AWS, advertising, and entertainment, in a dozen countries, with separate budgets and separate buying centers in each. We're already inside these organizations and the teams who use us love us. What we don't yet have is someone whose entire job is to turn a strong foothold into an enterprise-wide standard. That's this role.

This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the VP of Sales. You'll carry full commercial ownership of your accounts — expansion, cross-sell, pricing, and renewal — and an aggressive seven-figure growth target against them. You will not be working a wide territory or chasing net-new logos. You'll be going deep in a handful of the most important companies in the world, finding net new buying centers and getting introduced via referrals, building the relationships and the multi-year plan that make Outset the way they understand their customers.

You'll do it with a team around you. Each global account is supported by a dedicated account team — Sales Development, Research Operations, an Account Director, and a Solutions Consultant, with executive sponsorship from our leadership team. You set the strategy and direct the effort; the resources are there to execute it.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own a portfolio of a small number of strategic global accounts — companies on the scale of Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Meta, and Salesforce — with full commercial responsibility for expansion, cross-sell, pricing, and renewal.
* Find new buying centers, both regionally and within the larger umbrella brand, to pursue, predominantly via deep account understanding, referrals and in-person visits.
* Carry and exceed an aggressive seven-figure growth target across that portfolio.
* Build and maintain a live global account plan for each logo: every buying center by business unit, region, and research function; whitespace and spend map; executive relationship map; competitive position; and a dated path to each expansion.
* Multi-thread relentlessly — from practicing researchers to VPs to the C-suite — and build senior relationships durable enough to survive champion turnover, reorgs, and procurement cycles.
* Direct the extended account team (Sales Development, Research Operations, Account Director, Solutions Consultant, Marketing, and executive sponsors), setting priorities and holding the plan together across functions and time zones.
* Run executive business reviews that reframe the relationship around business outcomes, not usage stats, and convert them into committed budgets.
* Negotiate and close complex enterprise agreements — global MSAs, enterprise-wide and multi-region commitments, multi-year structures, enterprise procurement, security and privacy review — in partnership with Legal, Finance, and leadership.
* Coordinate coverage globally, aligning our regional teams behind a single account strategy rather than a set of local ones.
* Forecast with precision and keep a clean, current view of your accounts in Salesforce.
* Bring the voice of your accounts back into Outset — informing product direction, pricing, and how we build the global account motion itself.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 10+ years in enterprise sales, including 5+ years in a named global or strategic account role (Global Account Manager, Global Account Director, Strategic Account Manager, or equivalent) owning a small book of major brands.
* Direct experience selling into and growing accounts of this profile — large, global, matrixed technology or consumer organizations with many buying centers, such as Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Meta, or Salesforce.
* A proven record of exceeding aggressive seven-figure growth targets *inside existing accounts* — expansion, cross-sell, and renewal — not only net-new logo attainment.
* World-class relationship management. You are known for the depth and durability of the relationships you build, and you can point to accounts you grew over years, not quarters.
* Executive presence and commercial sharpness: credible with CxO and VP-level buyers, consultative enough to teach and shape their thinking, and comfortable negotiating at scale.
* Demonstrated ability to lead an extended, cross-functional account team without direct authority — you make the people around you more effective on your accounts.
* Experience navigating complex global commercial structures: multi-region contracting, enterprise procurement, multi-year commitments, and competing internal stakeholders.
* Operational rigor — a real account planning methodology, accurate forecasting, and CRM discipline.
* High ownership, opinionated, proactive, and comfortable with a very fast pace of both decision-making and execution in a startup that is still building the playbook.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About Hyphenate**

Most AI companies in finance are building copilots. Hyphenate builds AI agents that do the work.

Hyphenate is the autonomous finance platform for the office of the CFO. Our agents run on top of a company's existing ERP, banks, billing, CRM and contracts, and take on the work itself: order-to-cash and revenue recognition, cash and treasury, procure-to-pay, general ledger and close, and reporting. They learn how each company runs finance, log every action for auditors, and escalate the decisions that need human judgment. No ERP migration, no rip-and-replace.

We are based in New York City and backed by a $9M seed round led by Foundation Capital, with BoldCap, Gaia Ventures, Aravind Srinivas (CEO of Perplexity) and finance leaders from Zuora, Ramp, Gusto, MongoDB, Zoom and the Big Four. Customers include Kiteworks, HiBid, Dura Software, Mini Melts and Rently.

**About the Role**

We are hiring Business Development Representatives to build the outbound engine for the office of the CFO.

The demand is already here. CFOs and Controllers at $100M to $1B companies are being asked by their CEOs how AI will change their teams, and we have the product that answers it. What we need is more conversations. Our BDRs are the people who start them: on the phone, every day, with the finance leaders who run the close, the cash and the revenue at companies in our target verticals.

This is a founding cohort. We are three Account Executives and three BDRs today and plan to be ten of each by the end of January. You will own a vertical, not a list: one segment of the market that you learn cold, prospect end to end, and build the playbook for. You report to our Head of Sales Development, who built the SDR organization at Rippling from three people to thirty, and you will get direct coaching from the CRO and the AEs you book for.

The BDR team is our farm system for Account Executives. We promote from within on discipline, coachability and execution, and we are adding AE seats fast enough that the path is real.

**What You'll Own**

* Own a vertical: run outbound into one segment of $100M to $1B companies (B2B software, CPG, manufacturing, wholesale distribution, construction, hospitality or health services) and become the person on the team who knows it best
* Live on the phone: roughly four hours a day of cold calls to CFOs, Controllers and VPs of Finance, with email and LinkedIn layered in as we stand those channels up
* Book and hold 12 to 15 qualified meetings a month at full ramp, and hand each one to your AE with a real brief: who they are, what hurts, what systems they run, and what happens next
* Work inbound in your segment: content downloads and demo requests route to you, and you follow up the same day
* Research before you dial: ERP, close process, PE backing, hiring signals, so the first thirty seconds of every call land
* Partner with your AE on account plans, multi-threading into the finance org, and reviving closed-lost accounts
* Keep HubSpot clean: every call, meeting and note logged, so the funnel we run the business on is real
* Write and test talk tracks and sequences with the Head of Sales Development; what works becomes the playbook for the next ten BDRs
* Bring the market back inside: the objections you hear, the messaging that lands, and the segments that bite

**What You Should Have Done Before**

* Earned attention from strangers for a living. Either 6 to 24 months as an outbound BDR or SDR with a quota you hit, or a non-traditional background with hard evidence you can do measurable work under pressure: college athletics, a founder stint, client-facing finance or consulting
* Picked up the phone when it was the harder option. Cold calling is the core of this job today, and you should want it to be
* Held a conversation with a finance leader, or shown you can learn enough accounting to hold one within your first month
* Taken coaching well. You want your calls reviewed, and you change what you do when you get the feedback
* Executed a process every day without being chased: the activity, the logging, the follow-up
* Based in New York City or willing to relocate; we work from our Manhattan office five days a week
* High energy, high agency. You bring it to the floor and the people dialing next to you feel it

**You'll Stand Out If**

* You have prospected into finance buyers (CFO, Controller, treasury, RevOps) at a fintech, ERP, billing, close or spend-management company
* You have an accounting, audit or FP&A background, or a CPA you would rather use in a conversation than a spreadsheet
* You were a founding or early BDR somewhere and helped write the playbook, not just run it
* You build your own tooling: AI prospecting workflows, enrichment, call prep, anything that gets you to more of the right conversations
* You competed at a high level in something: Division I sports, a startup you founded, a job with a public scoreboard

**What Great Looks Like Here**

* You treat the phone as the best channel, not the last resort. A live conversation is the strongest pattern interrupt there is, and you go get it
* You want the AE seat, and you are earning it by doing the job in front of you better than anyone else
* You are curious about how a finance team actually closes the books, and you can explain what our agents do for one in two sentences
* You dial with the people next to you, share what is working, and make the floor louder

**The Upside**

* $90K base salary plus $50K in annual on-target commission, for a $140K OTE, and equity
* A real ramp: your first month of commission is guaranteed, month two runs on an adjusted quota, and you are at full ramp by month three
* A real path: the BDR team is where our next Account Executives come from, and we are adding AE seats as fast as we add BDRs
* Coaching every week from a Head of Sales Development who has scaled this exact function, plus call feedback from the CRO and the AEs you book for
* Medical, dental and vision co

**About Us**
------------

Sydecar is on a mission to transform the world of private markets. Our goal is to make these markets more accessible, transparent, and liquid, and we're achieving this by revolutionizing the way investment vehicles are created and executed.

At Sydecar, we're not just a platform; we're a trusted partner in venture capital. We're dedicated to simplifying and standardizing the private investing experience, empowering capital allocators to discover and support visionary entrepreneurs who are shaping the future.

Our platform is designed with ease and efficiency in mind. We take care of all the behind-the-scenes tasks, from automating banking, ensuring compliance, handling contracts, managing taxes, to streamlining reporting. This leaves investors the freedom to concentrate on what matters most: making valuable deals and nurturing meaningful relationships.

Join us at Sydecar, as we lead the charge in revolutionizing private investing.

**About the opportunity**
-------------------------

We are seeking an experienced and motivated Business Development Manager to build, coach, and lead our BDR team. In this player-coach role, you will own top-of-funnel pipeline generation for our sales team: developing and hiring BDRs, designing and running inbound and outbound campaigns in partnership with our marketing team, and setting the processes and metrics that turn leads into qualified meetings. You will work directly with sales leadership to scale how Sydecar reaches emerging fund managers, independent venture managers, and other capital allocators, while still engaging high-priority prospects yourself. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who has excelled as a BDR, loves developing others, and wants to build and lead a team at a fast-growing fintech.  
  
*This is a hybrid role based in New York City with in-office attendance of three days per week.*

**What you'll be doing**
------------------------

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of BDRs through regular 1:1s, call and email reviews, and ongoing training on our products.
* Own the BDR team's pipeline targets, including meetings set, qualified opportunities, and conversion to closed deals, and hold the team accountable to clear weekly KPIs.
* Partner with marketing and sales leadership to design, launch, and measure inbound and outbound campaigns targeting emerging fund managers, independent venture managers,syndicate leads, and other capital allocators.
* Refine lead qualification criteria, and handoff processes with our Account Executives to improve speed-to-lead and conversion rates.
* Build and maintain the BDR playbook, including messaging, sequences, objection handling, and onboarding materials for new team members.
* Ensure accurate, up-to-date records in our CRM system (Hubspot) and build reporting that gives leadership clear visibility into funnel performance.
* Analyze funnel data to identify trends, bottlenecks, and opportunities, and share regular updates and recommendations with sales leadership.
* Help recruit, interview, and onboard new BDRs as the team grows.
* Maintain a personal pipeline goal, engaging high-priority prospects and modeling best practices for the team.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* Undergraduate degree from an accredited college or university.
* 3-5 years of experience in sales or business development, including at least 1-2 years as a top-performing BDR/SDR with a track record of exceeding pipeline and quota targets.
* Experience leading, coaching, or mentoring reps, whether as a formal manager or an informal team lead.
* Experience building sales processes, playbooks, and campaigns, and using data to make decisions and coach reps.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly.
* Highly organized, with the ability to balance team leadership and individual contributions.
* Advanced proficiency with CRM software (i.e., HubSpot) and sales enrichment tools (i.e. Clay)
* Working knowledge of AI tools and experience incorporating them into daily workflows to drive efficiency and revenue growth.

**Bonus if you have**
---------------------

* Experience selling in financial services, alternative investments, or fintech.
* Experience at a startup, especially building and scaling a sales team from an early stage as well as building new outbound motions.
* Experience in fund administration or have sold to fund managers, VCs, or other capital allocators.
* Knowledgeable and passionate about venture capital and/or private markets.

**Sydecar’s values**
--------------------

***Our values are important to the way we live and work at Sydecar. They guide our priorities, behaviors and interactions.***

**Be Committed**

As a team, we rise to meet challenges and recognize that we become stronger and develop character when facing adversity.

**Be Excellent**

We measure our success not just by what we achieve, but by how we achieve it—through integrity, creativity, elegance, and a commitment to continuous improvement. Excellence is not just doing things well—it's looking for ways to do them better.

**Be Humble**

Humility is our key to personal and professional growth. We appreciate that great ideas can come from anywhere, regardless of seniority, pedigree, or experience. We care more about collective outcomes than who gets credit or who does what. We try to not let our ego cloud our judgment.

**Win Together**

Winning is no accident. It is the result of collective hard work, perseverance, sacrifice, and most of all, loving what we do. Winning requires that we give extra—sometimes winning calls for late nights or extra effort, and we show up for clients and each other with urgency and heart. While excellence is a journey, winning is a destination.
