Serenity Home Inspections is looking for a highly organized, exceptionally detail-oriented **Client Care & Operations Coordinator** to become a key part of our day-to-day office operations.

This is not just a receptionist or scheduling role. This person will be the primary point of contact for clients and real estate agents, manage inspection scheduling and office workflows, coordinate with inspectors and virtual assistants, and help keep the operations side of the company running smoothly.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership, follows through, notices the small details, solves problems, and wants the opportunity to grow into a leadership role as the company expands.

What You’ll Do

* Serve as the primary person handling inbound calls, texts, emails, and new client inquiries.
* Schedule inspections and manage work orders in **ISN (Inspection Support Network)**.
* Review property details, client needs, and available services to help clients select the inspection services that make sense for their specific home.
* Coordinate inspection schedules, access, walkthroughs, inspectors, vendors, and ancillary services.
* Follow up on open quotes, incomplete online orders, missed calls, and unscheduled opportunities.
* Monitor outstanding reports, vendor services, agreements, payments, and other operational items.
* Maintain accurate client, agent, property, service, pricing, and scheduling information.
* Handle routine operational decisions and resolve normal scheduling or client-service issues without unnecessary escalation.
* Coordinate and collaborate with virtual assistant support to keep office tasks and follow-up moving.
* Assist with client retention, follow-up, and review-related communication.
* Help identify opportunities to improve office systems, communication, scheduling, and the overall client experience.
* Use tools such as **ISN, Zoom Phone, Microsoft Outlook, and ChatGPT** throughout the workday.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means more than answering the phone or scheduling inspections.

We are looking for someone who helps ensure that:

* Leads and missed calls are responded to quickly.
* Clients receive clear, helpful, and professional communication.
* Inspection schedules are accurate and efficient.
* Work orders are complete and properly documented.
* Clients are offered appropriate services based on their home and needs.
* Open quotes and incomplete orders receive consistent follow-up.
* Inspectors, vendors, clients, and agents have the information they need.
* Small errors are caught before they become larger problems.
* Open tasks are followed through until they are resolved.
* Routine operational issues are handled independently when appropriate.
* The day-to-day office operation runs smoothly without constant owner involvement.

Performance will be measured using KPIs such as **response time, call close rate, add-on service conversion, average work-order value, scheduling accuracy, follow-through, and customer satisfaction.**

Compensation & Benefits

* **$20–$24 per hour**, based on experience, skill level, and demonstrated ability.
* Overtime eligible when applicable. Overtime should be approved in advance.
* After 90 days, eligible employees may have the opportunity to participate in **monthly and quarterly KPI-based performance bonuses**.
* Performance bonuses are designed to reward strong individual results, consistency, accuracy, client service, and contribution to company goals.
* Annual Christmas bonus based on company profitability.
* Paid holidays.
* **Paid Time Off (PTO) provided according to company policy.**

Schedule & Work Location

This is a **full-time hourly position**.

Scheduled shifts will generally fall within approximately **8:00 AM–7:00 PM Eastern, Monday through Friday**, depending on business coverage needs.

This is the company’s coverage window, **not an 11-hour daily shift**. The employee’s regular schedule will be discussed during the hiring process.

This position is intended to be **hybrid**.

An Atlanta-area/local candidate is preferred because the role is ideally in-office approximately **one day per week** at our Peachtree Corners office for collaboration and operational work.

Fully remote arrangements may be considered for **exceptional candidates with significant relevant experience and a demonstrated ability to independently manage similar responsibilities.**

What We’re Looking For

The right person will have:

* **Exceptional attention to detail.**
* Strong organizational and follow-through skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Confidence speaking with clients and real estate professionals by phone.
* Strong customer-service instincts.
* The ability to stay calm, organized, and accurate while managing multiple priorities.
* Good judgment and the ability to make routine operational decisions independently.
* Strong computer and technology skills.
* Comfort learning and working across multiple software platforms.
* Comfort using AI tools such as ChatGPT as part of normal workflow.
* A proactive mindset — someone who notices what needs to be done rather than waiting to be told.
* Strong problem-solving skills.
* A desire to take ownership and grow with the company.

Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred:

* Operations coordination
* Dispatch or scheduling
* Inside sales
* Customer service
* Real estate
* CRM or scheduling software
* Multi-line phone systems

Previous home inspection industry experience is welcome but **not required**.

College education is preferred but not required. Relevant experience, communication ability, judgment, technology skills, and attention to detail are more important.

Local candidates should be able to reliably attend the expected in-office schedule in Peachtree Corners.

Sales

**Who we are:**
---------------

Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.

Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes.

Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram.

**Who you are:**
----------------

We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Business Development Associate who will be responsible for driving new and expansion revenue within our small and medium-sized business (SMB) customer segment, helping fleets of 5 to 50 vehicles discover how Geotab can transform their operations. This is an exciting early-career sales opportunity for someone who thrives in front of customers, delivers engaging product demonstrations, and is ready to grow their career with industry-leading coaching. If you love connecting with customers and showcasing technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

As a Business Development Associate your key area of responsibility will be achieving an individual Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) growth target by managing an assigned list of SMB leads, accounts, and opportunities. You will be responsible for prospecting and qualifying new opportunities, engaging inbound leads in your territory, running discovery conversations to understand each customer’s fleet challenges, and delivering clear, compelling presentations and live product demonstrations that connect customer needs to the right Geotab solutions. Customer demos are a central part of this role, so you will spend much of your time showing prospects how Geotab works in practice. You will also need to advance opportunities through partner and referral programs, keep opportunity stages, activities, and next steps accurate in Salesloft and Salesforce, and build your knowledge of telematics, fleet management, competitors, and market trends. You will need to work closely with Business Development leadership, Revenue Operations, Partner Account Managers, and Marketing to progress opportunities and share customer and market insights that shape planning and forecasting. Our ideal candidate is able to support customers in the Pacific time zone.

To be successful in this role you will be a confident communicator and presenter who is coachable, resilient, curious, and motivated by measurable goals. In addition, the successful candidate will have strong organization and time management skills, the ability to learn technical and business concepts quickly, and the drive to build the product, industry, and sales expertise needed to progress into a Business Development Representative role.

**How you’ll make an impact:**
------------------------------

* Manage an assigned list of SMB accounts and sales opportunities, typically serving fleets with 5 to 50 vehicles but may differ by segment.
* Use established partner and referral programs, including emerging SMB initiatives, to generate qualified pipeline and advance standard SMB opportunities through the sales process at high velocities.
* Deliver clear presentations, product overviews, and demonstrations appropriate to the customer's needs.

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**
====================

The Operations Coordinator is responsible for coordinating and managing the flow of materials, equipment, vendor commitments, logistics, field scheduling, and service activity required to support Solar Energy Partners Operations. The role is the primary Operations owner for material readiness, procurement visibility, and the field schedule for all field work, including installations, site surveys, and service visits, and is accountable for ensuring that service work is properly received, documented, coordinated, tracked, and moved through completion.

**Core Accountabilities**
=========================

**Procurement & Cost Control**
------------------------------

* Coordinate purchasing of approved project materials, equipment, rentals, and other assigned operational requirements.
* Obtain, compare, and document vendor pricing, availability, lead times, and delivery commitments.
* Create and maintain clear visibility of purchase status, backorders, substitutions, and expected delivery dates.
* Support project cost control by maintaining accurate purchasing information and identifying material or vendor cost risks early.
* Escalate material substitutions, design conflicts, or specification questions for technical approval before purchase.

**Material Readiness & Logistics**
----------------------------------

* Maintain forward visibility of material requirements for the active installation schedule and identify jobs at risk because of material, equipment, or vendor constraints.
* Coordinate receiving, inventory location, staging, job pulls, transfers, deliveries, and other assigned logistics activities.
* Coordinate equipment rentals and related delivery/pickup requirements as assigned.
* Work with Field Operations and Project Management to confirm that required materials are available before scheduled work begins.

**Field Scheduling**
--------------------

* Own the schedule for all field work, including installations, site surveys, service visits, and other assigned field activities.
* Schedule work only after prerequisites are confirmed, including material readiness, permit/interconnection milestones, customer availability, and crew and equipment availability.
* Coordinate with Field Operations on crew availability, capacity, job duration estimates, and sequencing to build a realistic, conflict-free schedule.
* Confirm appointments with customers and communicate schedule changes promptly to customers, field crews, Project Management, and other affected stakeholders.
* Manage reschedules, cancellations, weather delays, and scheduling conflicts, and keep the schedule current in Coperniq.
* Maintain forward visibility of the upcoming field schedule and crew capacity, and flag gaps, overbooking, or jobs at risk of slipping.

**Service Coordination**
------------------------

* Receive and organize service requests in accordance with the approved Operations workflow.
* Ensure service opportunities, work orders, notes, supporting documentation, and status information are entered and maintained in Coperniq.
* Coordinate service needs with Field Operations and schedule field service visits in accordance with the approved workflow.
* Track open service items from intake through field completion, documentation, closeout, and readiness for invoicing.
* Escalate service items that are aging, blocked, customer-sensitive, or likely to affect cost or schedule.

**Systems, Documentation & Reporting**
======================================

* Maintain complete and timely procurement, logistics, service, and vendor notes in Coperniq and other approved company systems.
* Document significant vendor communications, delivery commitments, shortages, backorders, schedule changes, service updates, and resolution status in the applicable job or opportunity file.
* Maintain weekly visibility of open purchase orders, material readiness, backorders, the upcoming field schedule, upcoming installation risks, service backlog, and completed service activity.
* Participate in Operations scorecard, KPI, L10, and other reporting processes as assigned by the Office Operations Manager.
* Support actual-cost and project-profitability reporting by providing accurate purchasing, rental, and material information when requested.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**
=================================

* Coordinate with Field Operations on field scheduling, crew capacity, installation readiness, site needs, service execution, deliveries, and material-related field issues.
* Coordinate with Project Managers on project timing, installation and site survey scheduling, permit/interconnection milestones, customer commitments, and material requirements.
* Work with HR, Accounting, and other administrative functions as needed to support approved Operations processes and documentation.

**Performance Expectations**
============================

* Material readiness for scheduled work and early identification of procurement or logistics risks.
* An accurate, current field schedule with prerequisites confirmed before work is dispatched, and timely communication of schedule changes.
* Timely and accurate purchase, vendor, delivery, and inventory status information.
* Consistent management of service intake, backlog, aging, documentation, and completion status.
* Accurate and timely use of Coperniq, including required notes and task/status updates.
* Responsiveness, ownership, communication, and follow-through across Operations handoffs.
* Achievement of assigned weekly scorecard measures and quarterly KPI targets.

**Qualifications / Capabilities**
=================================

* Strong organization, prioritization, follow-up, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple vendors, projects, deadlines, and competing operational priorities.

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
Stratix Corporation is the trusted advisor for many industry-leading global enterprises, offering the most comprehensive managed services portfolio to help companies operationalize and realize the full value of their mobile investments. Our passion is partnering with businesses to operationalize their mobile investments with high-value services that drive competitive differentiation.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Logistics Coordinator manages domestic and international shipping operations to ensure timely, compliant, and cost-effective movement of goods. This role coordinates transportation, documentation, customs requirements, and shipment tracking while maintaining accurate records and resolving logistical issues.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with hazardous materials (HAZMAT) shipping, including applicable regulatory and documentation requirements, as well as international freight and customs processes. Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills are essential for coordinating with carriers, suppliers, customers, and internal teams.

**Responsibilities Include:**
-----------------------------

* Pick, pack, and prepare customer orders for shipment in accordance with invoices, work orders, or pick lists.
* Ensure all outgoing shipments are securely packaged, properly labeled, and meet company and carrier requirements.
* Print, apply, and verify shipping labels, barcodes, packing slips, and related documentation.
* Coordinate with carriers (UPS, FedEx, DHL, freight companies, etc.) to schedule pickups, track deliveries, and resolve shipping issues.
* Perform quality checks on outgoing shipments to confirm accuracy of items, quantities, and condition.
* Update inventory systems to reflect shipped items and maintain accurate shipping records.
* Operate warehouse equipment (pallet jacks, forklifts) safely and in compliance with company policies.
* Follow warehouse safety procedures and comply with shipping regulations, including hazardous materials handling (if applicable).
* Assist with receiving inbound shipments, cycle counts, and inventory audits as needed.
* Support warehouse team members and contribute to process improvement initiatives to enhance shipping efficiency.
* All other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications****:**
-----------------------

* 3-5 years of experience.
* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Previous warehouse or shipping/receiving experience preferred.
* Basic computer skills and familiarity with inventory management or shipping software.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. and stand/walk for extended periods.
* Effective communication and teamwork skills.
* Forklift certification (or willingness to obtain) preferred.

---------------------

* Warehouse setting with exposure to varying temperatures.
* Fast-paced, team-oriented environment with deadlines to meet.
* Requires use of some safety equipment.

jobs.description:
**Overview**

The Marketing Coordinator is a creative, design-focused member of the marketing team responsible for bringing our brand, events, and neighborhood initiatives to life across social, digital, email, and print channels.

Graphic design is at the heart of this role. The Marketing Coordinator will lead the day-to-day execution of creative materials for our core events, programs, and campaigns while helping establish a consistent and compelling visual identity across the organization.

In addition to design, this position will support social media content creation and management, website and email marketing, and other special marketing projects. The ideal candidate is a strong visual storyteller who can move comfortably between creative execution and collaborative project work.

This role works closely with the Marketing Director and regularly collaborates with staff, committees, Board members, businesses, vendors, and community partners.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Graphic Design & Creative*

A significant portion of this position will be dedicated to graphic design and creative production.

* Lead day-to-day graphic design for organizational marketing campaigns, programs, and events.
* Develop creative concepts and visual systems for major events and initiatives.
* Design assets across a wide range of formats, including social media, email, websites, digital advertising, signage, posters, flyers, event materials, and other print collateral.
* Help establish and maintain a cohesive design ethos across the organization's marketing channels.
* Adapt campaign creative across multiple formats while maintaining consistency and quality.
* Prepare production-ready files for print vendors and other external partners.
* Maintain organized creative files, templates, brand assets, and project archives.
* Bring a strong design point of view while remaining flexible enough to incorporate organizational and stakeholder feedback.

*Social Media & Content Creation*

* Create engaging social media graphics, short-form content, and other visual assets.
* Assist with management of the organization's social media channels and content calendar.
* Capture photo and video content in the neighborhood and at organizational events when needed.
* Create and edit Reels, Stories, posts, carousels, and other social-first content.
* Help identify opportunities to showcase member businesses, events, neighborhood experiences, and community stories.
* Ensure social content remains visually consistent with the organization's overall brand and marketing strategy.

*Digital & Email Marketing*

* Design graphics and supporting creative for email marketing campaigns.
* Assist with the production and deployment of newsletters and promotional emails.
* Support updates to organizational websites and landing pages.
* Create digital assets for event pages, ticketing platforms, advertising campaigns, and partner promotions.
* Work with the Marketing Director to ensure creative is optimized for the appropriate platform and audience.

*Marketing Coordination & Special Projects*

* Work closely with the Marketing Director to execute broader marketing campaigns and initiatives.
* Translate strategic direction into polished creative deliverables.
* Implement feedback from Board members, committees, staff, and other stakeholders while maintaining the integrity of the creative concept.
* Coordinate with printers, photographers, videographers, contractors, agencies, and other creative vendors as needed.
* Support special events, neighborhood campaigns, business promotions, and other organizational initiatives.

**What the Day-to-Day Looks Like**

There will be **a lot of design time.** On any given day, you might be developing the visual direction for an upcoming event, turning that concept into social and email graphics, preparing signage for print, editing a Reel, updating a webpage, or working with the Marketing Director to incorporate committee feedback into a campaign.

This is a hands-on creative role. While you'll participate in strategy and planning conversations, you'll spend much of your time actually making things.

You'll also work in an environment with multiple stakeholders. Being able to receive feedback, understand the objective behind it, and translate it into strong creative work is an important part of succeeding in this position.

**Qualifications**

*Required*

* Strong proficiency in **Adobe Photoshop and the Adobe Creative Suite**, with approximately 3–4 years of hands-on experience.
* Candidates with a degree in Graphic Design or a closely related field may be considered with at least 1 year of relevant professional experience.
* Strong graphic design portfolio demonstrating excellent typography, composition, hierarchy, branding, and visual storytelling.
* Strong creative point of view and understanding of contemporary design across digital, social, and print mediums.
* Experience designing for social media and digital marketing.
* Ability to take creative direction and independently execute projects from concept through final production.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Ability to navigate feedback from multiple stakeholders with professionalism, diplomacy, and good judgment.
* Strong attention to detail.

*Preferred*

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

* Canva
* WordPress and Elementor
* Google Workspace
* Email marketing platforms
* Social media management and scheduling platforms
* Short-form video editing
* Photography and videography
* Print production and vendor coordination

jobs.description:
**Who we Are?**

Intersection is an experience-driven Out of Home media and technology company that delivers programming, consumer amenities, and advertising to cities. From free internet access to way-finding to real-time information, our products make city life easier and more sustainable. We further enrich cities with experiential programming that inspires and engages people throughout their day. With valuable, diverse audiences in America’s top cities, we provide innovative, data-driven solutions for brands to reach urbanites at scale.

**What is the Role?**

Intersection is seeking an upbeat, energetic, and self-motivated Sales Coordinator to join the Client Success Team and work in one of our Central offices! This is a fast-paced, detail-oriented, and varied role that is perfect for someone who has experience in sales support within the media/advertising world. The ideal candidate will have outstanding interpersonal and customer service skills, have a drive to learn and the ability to perform sales support responsibilities and thrive within a team environment. Above all, this individual will provide full support to their Sales Account Executive(s), improve the sales cycles by aiding to activate new processes to ensure we live by “The Intersection Way” - maintaining a collaborative and consultative effort with our Clients.

**What you will accomplish:**

**Within your first month:**

* You will build strong relationships with your Manager, the Account Executives and Account Manager that they support
* You will onboard/train with one of the Client Success Sales Ambassadors
* You will take a deep dive into learning Intersections media and advertising offerings
* You will be a Mentee to other Sales Coordinators to learn the process and systems used within the sales support organization
* You will be exposed to all departments within Intersection and experience how they are part of the sales cycle

**Within your first three-six months:**

* You will be able to support your Account Executives/Account Managers by generating and processing contracts, proposals, and presentations that enable Intersection to scale rapidly
* You will gain exposure and have daily communication with our Clients/Agencies
* You will manage all inventory requests, inventory holds, market avails, media plans / proposals for your Account Executives/Account Managers book of business
* You will generate targeting maps and visuals for RFP responses
* You will handle invoicing requests / billing inquiries
* You will own the pre-sale lifecycle of a contract: initial market research to contract creation and execution, to artwork / specification requests, track production process
* You will research and document competitive requests
* Develop a reputation for being a solid resource and will develop the foundational knowledge of our business model and the various media products and assets
* You will be a “go-to” person who gets stuff done accurately and on time, whether it’s printing materials, setting up meetings with our clients, or building sales decks from scratch
* You will be communicating over email / by phone with internal resources (charting, ad ops, inventory, & account teams) and our Clients to ensure a smooth & positive customer service experience
* You will be a member of a great team at Intersection!

**You're a great fit for this role because:**

* You have a degree from an Accredited Institution
* You have 1-2+ years relevant work experience in a customer-facing customer success, account management or strategic consulting organization
* You can multi-task a number of different items
* You enjoy collaborating with people to get work done, but know when to take ownership of a task
* You demonstrate a high level of accountability for both your work and the work of your team
* You have strong attention to detail and can spot and fix errors
* You work fast but thoughtfully, and make suggestions for efficiencies along the way
* You have knowledge of Adobe and Microsoft Office Suite and do not mind busy work utilizing these tools for RFPs

Total Cash compensation: $50,000 - $55,000

**Hybrid Work Policy:** Our team operates on a hybrid schedule to balance flexibility with face-to-face collaboration. We require all employees to be in the office every Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely the remainder of the week.

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
ABOUT 8FLEET

8Fleet is hiring! We are a fast-growing technology and logistics company building the operational backbone for rideshare fleets, both driver-operated and autonomous. We run 24/7 operations with full-time drivers, a managed fleet of vehicles and a team that keeps it all moving. As we launch in Chicago, we are building our local team from the ground up.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an Operations Coordinator, based in Chicago, to keep our new market running every day. You will keep driver shifts covered, vehicles assigned and ready, and the team working from the same information. When something breaks at 6 a.m., you are the person who already knows and is fixing it.

This is an on-site, hands-on role for someone who likes a fast pace, thinks in systems and enjoys being the person everyone relies on. You will work closely with Chicago market leadership and help build the processes and reporting the team uses as the market grows. Strong coordinators here grow into supervisor, analyst and management roles.

SCHEDULE

Full-time, salaried, on-site in Chicago. This role supports a 24/7 operation, so some early mornings, evenings or weekends are expected, especially around launch.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Own Daily Coverage: Build and manage driver schedules and shift coverage, fill gaps quickly and keep vehicles earning.
* Keep Vehicles on the Road: Coordinate vehicle assignments, handoffs and availability with the Fleet Support and Maintenance teams so downtime stays low.
* Be the Operational Hub: Be the first point of contact for drivers and supervisors on day-to-day issues, and route what you cannot solve to the right owner fast.
* Run the Numbers: Track daily metrics such as coverage, utilization, attendance and vehicle status, and turn them into clear updates for leadership.
* Fix What Slows Us Down: Spot recurring problems, document how things should work and help put better processes and tools in place.
* Support the Launch: Help with onboarding logistics, driver communications, supplies and site needs as we stand up the Chicago market.

QUALIFICATIONS

* 2+ years in operations, dispatch, logistics, fleet, transportation or another fast-moving operations environment.
* Strong organization and follow-through: you close loops without being chased.
* Comfort with data. You are strong in Google Sheets or Excel and like using numbers to make decisions.
* Clear, calm communication with drivers, teammates and leadership, especially when things go sideways.
* Flexibility to support a 24/7 operation, including some early mornings, evenings or weekends.

NICE TO HAVE

* Experience in rideshare, delivery, rental car or fleet operations.
* Experience with scheduling or fleet tools such as Deputy, Samsara, Fleetio or similar.
* Experience launching a new market, site or operation.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish).

WHY 8FLEET

* Get in early and help build the Chicago operation, not just run it.
* Clear paths into supervisor, analyst and operations management roles as we scale.
* Medical, dental and vision, 401(k), paid time off and sick pay.

COMPENSATION

* $65,000 - $70,000 per year, plus equity

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

8Fleet is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Disclaimer: This job description may be updated at any time without prior notice.

Compensation Range: $65K - $70K

**ROOFCORP of America, Inc.**

Sales Coordinator Commercial Roofing | Anaheim, California Full-time, on-site | Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM | No nights, no weekends

**ABOUT ROOFCORP OF AMERICA**

We have been repairing, restoring, and replacing commercial flat roofs since 1985. We specialize in TPO, built-up roofing, and silicone restoration for building owners and property managers across California, Oregon, Washington, and Alaska. We are a family-run company with more than 40 years in business and offices in Anaheim, Seattle, and Bogotá, Colombia. Many of our people have been with us for twenty years or more. We operate on a simple standard: do honest work, do it right, and take care of the customer. Quality here is personal, not a department.

**JOB OVERVIEW**

The Sales Coordinator is the hub of our Pacific Southwest sales operation. Our estimators are out on roofs and our sales team is in front of customers. You are the person who makes sure nothing behind them falls through the cracks: proposals go out on time, bids are submitted before the deadline, follow-ups actually happen, and customer records stay accurate. This is a visible role with real ownership. You will work directly with our Anaheim field team, our Sales Manager in Seattle, and our back office in Bogotá. If you are organized, you like deadlines, and you take pride in catching mistakes before anyone else does, you will do well here.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

- Log incoming leads, service calls, and bid invitations accurately, the same day they arrive. - Build proposals and roof condition reports from estimator field notes and photos, clean, professional, and error-free before they reach a customer.

- Track the bid board: due dates, addenda, plan-room submittals, and prequalification packets. - Schedule roof inspections and estimator appointments, coordinating routes so field time is used well.

- Follow up on open proposals on a set schedule and keep the pipeline current. - Maintain customer and project records: contacts, insurance certificates, W-9s, and vendor portal registrations.

- Produce a weekly pipeline and activity report for the Sales Manager.

**REQUIREMENTS**

- Two or more years in sales coordination, project administration, estimating support, or inside sales support.

- Construction, roofing, or another skilled trade is a strong plus, but we will train the right person. - Excellent written English. Your documents go directly to building owners and property managers.

- The ability to learn new software quickly.

- Genuine attention to detail. In this seat, a wrong address or a missed deadline costs real money.

- Reliable on-site attendance, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM.

- An associate's degree is preferred but not required. We value hands-on experience equally.

**PREFERRED**

- Bilingual English/Spanish. - Experience with CRM systems or construction bid platforms such as BuildingConnected, iSqFt, Procore, or PlanHub.

- Experience serving commercial property management customers.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

- $28.00 – $34.00 per hour, depending on experience. Candidates with commercial roofing, bid platform, or property management experience start at the upper end of the range.

- Paid sick leave. - Paid holidays.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Apply through Indeed with your resume. Please include a short note of a few sentences telling us why this role is a good fit for you. In this position, written communication matters, and we read every note. ROOFCORP of America, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act.

Pay: $28.00 - $34.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Work Location: In person

* Represent the program at community meetings and stakeholder events to support collaborative initiatives and partnership development.

* Prepare analytical reports and present findings and recommendations to program leadership to support program planning and decision-making.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  + Bachelor's degree in public health, healthcare administration, social sciences, or a related discipline and a minimum of four years of relevant experience; or an equivalent combination of education and related experience, including a minimum of six years of relevant work experience.

**About Hyphenate**

Most AI companies in finance are building copilots. Hyphenate builds AI agents that do the work.

Hyphenate is the autonomous finance platform for the office of the CFO. Our agents run on top of a company's existing ERP, banks, billing, CRM and contracts, and take on the work itself: order-to-cash and revenue recognition, cash and treasury, procure-to-pay, general ledger and close, and reporting. They learn how each company runs finance, log every action for auditors, and escalate the decisions that need human judgment. No ERP migration, no rip-and-replace.

We are based in New York City and backed by a $9M seed round led by Foundation Capital, with BoldCap, Gaia Ventures, Aravind Srinivas (CEO of Perplexity) and finance leaders from Zuora, Ramp, Gusto, MongoDB, Zoom and the Big Four. Customers include Kiteworks, HiBid, Dura Software, Mini Melts and Rently.

**About the Role**

We are hiring Business Development Representatives to build the outbound engine for the office of the CFO.

The demand is already here. CFOs and Controllers at $100M to $1B companies are being asked by their CEOs how AI will change their teams, and we have the product that answers it. What we need is more conversations. Our BDRs are the people who start them: on the phone, every day, with the finance leaders who run the close, the cash and the revenue at companies in our target verticals.

This is a founding cohort. We are three Account Executives and three BDRs today and plan to be ten of each by the end of January. You will own a vertical, not a list: one segment of the market that you learn cold, prospect end to end, and build the playbook for. You report to our Head of Sales Development, who built the SDR organization at Rippling from three people to thirty, and you will get direct coaching from the CRO and the AEs you book for.

The BDR team is our farm system for Account Executives. We promote from within on discipline, coachability and execution, and we are adding AE seats fast enough that the path is real.

**What You'll Own**

* Own a vertical: run outbound into one segment of $100M to $1B companies (B2B software, CPG, manufacturing, wholesale distribution, construction, hospitality or health services) and become the person on the team who knows it best

* Write and test talk tracks and sequences with the Head of Sales Development; what works becomes the playbook for the next ten BDRs
* Bring the market back inside: the objections you hear, the messaging that lands, and the segments that bite

**What You Should Have Done Before**

* Earned attention from strangers for a living. Either 6 to 24 months as an outbound BDR or SDR with a quota you hit, or a non-traditional background with hard evidence you can do measurable work under pressure: college athletics, a founder stint, client-facing finance or consulting
* Picked up the phone when it was the harder option. Cold calling is the core of this job today, and you should want it to be
* Held a conversation with a finance leader, or shown you can learn enough accounting to hold one within your first month
* Taken coaching well. You want your calls reviewed, and you change what you do when you get the feedback
* Executed a process every day without being chased: the activity, the logging, the follow-up
* Based in New York City or willing to relocate; we work from our Manhattan office five days a week
* High energy, high agency. You bring it to the floor and the people dialing next to you feel it

**You'll Stand Out If**

* You have prospected into finance buyers (CFO, Controller, treasury, RevOps) at a fintech, ERP, billing, close or spend-management company
* You have an accounting, audit or FP&A background, or a CPA you would rather use in a conversation than a spreadsheet
* You were a founding or early BDR somewhere and helped write the playbook, not just run it
* You build your own tooling: AI prospecting workflows, enrichment, call prep, anything that gets you to more of the right conversations
* You competed at a high level in something: Division I sports, a startup you founded, a job with a public scoreboard

**What Great Looks Like Here**

* You want the AE seat, and you are earning it by doing the job in front of you better than anyone else
* You are curious about how a finance team actually closes the books, and you can explain what our agents do for one in two sentences
* You dial with the people next to you, share what is working, and make the floor louder

**The Upside**

new_jobs.title: Client Care & Operations Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Client Care & Operations Coordinator

**Serenity Home Inspections – Peachtree Corners, GA**  
**$20–$24 per hour | Full-Time | Hybrid**

Serenity Home Inspections is looking for a highly organized, exceptionally detail-oriented **Client Care & Operations Coordinator** to become a key part of our day-to-day office operations.

This is not just a receptionist or scheduling role. This person will be the primary point of contact for clients and real estate agents, manage inspection scheduling and office workflows, coordinate with inspectors and virtual assistants, and help keep the operations side of the company running smoothly.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership, follows through, notices the small details, solves problems, and wants the opportunity to grow into a leadership role as the company expands.

What You’ll Do

* Serve as the primary person handling inbound calls, texts, emails, and new client inquiries.
* Schedule inspections and manage work orders in **ISN (Inspection Support Network)**.
* Review property details, client needs, and available services to help clients select the inspection services that make sense for their specific home.
* Coordinate inspection schedules, access, walkthroughs, inspectors, vendors, and ancillary services.
* Follow up on open quotes, incomplete online orders, missed calls, and unscheduled opportunities.
* Monitor outstanding reports, vendor services, agreements, payments, and other operational items.
* Maintain accurate client, agent, property, service, pricing, and scheduling information.
* Handle routine operational decisions and resolve normal scheduling or client-service issues without unnecessary escalation.
* Coordinate and collaborate with virtual assistant support to keep office tasks and follow-up moving.
* Assist with client retention, follow-up, and review-related communication.
* Help identify opportunities to improve office systems, communication, scheduling, and the overall client experience.
* Use tools such as **ISN, Zoom Phone, Microsoft Outlook, and ChatGPT** throughout the workday.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means more than answering the phone or scheduling inspections.

We are looking for someone who helps ensure that:

* Leads and missed calls are responded to quickly.
* Clients receive clear, helpful, and professional communication.
* Inspection schedules are accurate and efficient.
* Work orders are complete and properly documented.
* Clients are offered appropriate services based on their home and needs.
* Open quotes and incomplete orders receive consistent follow-up.
* Inspectors, vendors, clients, and agents have the information they need.
* Small errors are caught before they become larger problems.
* Open tasks are followed through until they are resolved.
* Routine operational issues are handled independently when appropriate.
* The day-to-day office operation runs smoothly without constant owner involvement.

Performance will be measured using KPIs such as **response time, call close rate, add-on service conversion, average work-order value, scheduling accuracy, follow-through, and customer satisfaction.**

Compensation & Benefits

* **$20–$24 per hour**, based on experience, skill level, and demonstrated ability.
* Overtime eligible when applicable. Overtime should be approved in advance.
* After 90 days, eligible employees may have the opportunity to participate in **monthly and quarterly KPI-based performance bonuses**.
* Performance bonuses are designed to reward strong individual results, consistency, accuracy, client service, and contribution to company goals.
* Annual Christmas bonus based on company profitability.
* Paid holidays.
* **Paid Time Off (PTO) provided according to company policy.**

Schedule & Work Location

This is a **full-time hourly position**.

Scheduled shifts will generally fall within approximately **8:00 AM–7:00 PM Eastern, Monday through Friday**, depending on business coverage needs.

This is the company’s coverage window, **not an 11-hour daily shift**. The employee’s regular schedule will be discussed during the hiring process.

This position is intended to be **hybrid**.

An Atlanta-area/local candidate is preferred because the role is ideally in-office approximately **one day per week** at our Peachtree Corners office for collaboration and operational work.

Fully remote arrangements may be considered for **exceptional candidates with significant relevant experience and a demonstrated ability to independently manage similar responsibilities.**

What We’re Looking For

The right person will have:

* **Exceptional attention to detail.**
* Strong organizational and follow-through skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Confidence speaking with clients and real estate professionals by phone.
* Strong customer-service instincts.
* The ability to stay calm, organized, and accurate while managing multiple priorities.
* Good judgment and the ability to make routine operational decisions independently.
* Strong computer and technology skills.
* Comfort learning and working across multiple software platforms.
* Comfort using AI tools such as ChatGPT as part of normal workflow.
* A proactive mindset — someone who notices what needs to be done rather than waiting to be told.
* Strong problem-solving skills.
* A desire to take ownership and grow with the company.

Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred:

* Operations coordination
* Dispatch or scheduling
* Inside sales
* Customer service
* Real estate
* CRM or scheduling software
* Multi-line phone systems

Previous home inspection industry experience is welcome but **not required**.

College education is preferred but not required. Relevant experience, communication ability, judgment, technology skills, and attention to detail are more important.

Local candidates should be able to reliably attend the expected in-office schedule in Peachtree Corners.

**Overview**

As a **Real Estate Business Development Consultant / Sales Representative**, you will drive revenue growth across land acquisitions, lot assignments, single-family home sales, and third-party construction contracts in Metro Atlanta. * **Pipeline & CRM Management:** Maintain clean records, register every opportunity in the company CRM before discussions begin, and track deals from origination to payout.

**Requirements**

* **Experience:** 3+ years of proven business development, B2B sales, or land acquisition experience in residential real estate, construction, or real estate investment.
* **Local Network:** An established network of real estate investors, builders, developers, brokers, or lenders in Metro Atlanta.
* **Track Record:** Demonstrated ability to independently manage a pipeline, negotiate contracts, and consistently close real estate transactions
* **Self-Directed:** Discipline to operate autonomously without day-to-day supervision while maintaining clear deal records in CRM.
* **Skills:** Strong negotiation, relationship-building, presentation, and CRM skills.

Work Location: In person

Fluid Flow is a trusted provider of compressed air solutions, helping industrial customers improve productivity, efficiency, and system reliability. We specialize in air compressors, dryers, filtration, blowers, and related compressed air equipment, backed by experienced technical support and comprehensive service capabilities. From equipment selection and system design to installation, maintenance, and repair, Fluid Flow delivers dependable solutions that help customers maximize uptime and performance.

Visit our website: fluidflow.com

Job Description:

**Summary**

The Outside Sales Representative is responsible for driving profitable growth within an assigned territory by selling compressed air equipment, air treatment products, nitrogen generation systems, and service agreements. This role requires strong technical aptitude, a consultative selling approach, and the ability to partner with customers across industrial environments. The representative will identify opportunities, develop engineered solutions, and ensure long-term customer satisfaction while meeting or exceeding sales targets.

**Responsibilities**

**Sales & Revenue Growth**

* Identify, pursue, and secure new customers for compressors, dryers, filtration, nitrogen generators, and turnkey system solutions.
* Grow existing accounts through strategic account planning and cross-selling of equipment and service offerings.
* Consistently achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales goals.
* Develop detailed territory and funnel plans to grow market share across key industrial segments.

**Customer & Application Expertise**

* Conduct plant walk-throughs, evaluate customer applications, and understand system requirements (air demand, quality needs, pressure profiles, energy efficiency).

* Deliver product presentations, proposals, and ROI analysis to maintenance leaders, plant managers, and executive decision-makers.
* Support customers through the full sales cycle—from opportunity identification to commissioning coordination.

**Technical & Product Knowledge**

* Maintain strong working knowledge of compressed air systems, including rotary screw, piston, and oil-free compressors, dryers, filtration, condensate management, and nitrogen generation.
* Understand service offerings such as planned maintenance, warranty extensions, audits, leak detection, and equipment upgrades.
* Stay current on industry innovations, competitive product lines, and energy efficiency technologies.

**Territory & Pipeline Management**

* Develop and execute a structured weekly plan for customer visits, prospecting, and follow-ups.
* Maintain accurate opportunity data, quoting status, and forecasting in CRM.
* Conduct on-site evaluations, energy assessments (when applicable), and coordinate air audits with internal technical teams.
* Attend industry events, trade shows, and customer trainings to expand pipeline and market presence.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with service teams to ensure excellent post-sale support and promote maintenance agreements.
* Partner with inside sales, engineering, and operations to deliver accurate quotes, equipment sizing, and project execution.
* Engage with marketing to support lead generation efforts and targeted campaigns.

**Qualifications**

* 2–5+ years of outside sales experience in industrial equipment, compressed air systems, HVAC, mechanical systems, or similar technical fields.
* Strong mechanical aptitude with the ability to learn complex systems.
* Proven record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Ability to interpret technical data such as CFM requirements, PSI, dew point, and energy usage.
* Proficiency in CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel frequently within the territory.

**Overview**

The Marketing Coordinator is a creative, design-focused member of the marketing team responsible for bringing our brand, events, and neighborhood initiatives to life across social, digital, email, and print channels.

Graphic design is at the heart of this role. The Marketing Coordinator will lead the day-to-day execution of creative materials for our core events, programs, and campaigns while helping establish a consistent and compelling visual identity across the organization.

In addition to design, this position will support social media content creation and management, website and email marketing, and other special marketing projects. The ideal candidate is a strong visual storyteller who can move comfortably between creative execution and collaborative project work.

This role works closely with the Marketing Director and regularly collaborates with staff, committees, Board members, businesses, vendors, and community partners.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Graphic Design & Creative*

A significant portion of this position will be dedicated to graphic design and creative production.

* Lead day-to-day graphic design for organizational marketing campaigns, programs, and events.
* Develop creative concepts and visual systems for major events and initiatives.
* Design assets across a wide range of formats, including social media, email, websites, digital advertising, signage, posters, flyers, event materials, and other print collateral.
* Help establish and maintain a cohesive design ethos across the organization's marketing channels.
* Adapt campaign creative across multiple formats while maintaining consistency and quality.
* Prepare production-ready files for print vendors and other external partners.
* Maintain organized creative files, templates, brand assets, and project archives.
* Bring a strong design point of view while remaining flexible enough to incorporate organizational and stakeholder feedback.

*Social Media & Content Creation*

* Create engaging social media graphics, short-form content, and other visual assets.
* Assist with management of the organization's social media channels and content calendar.
* Capture photo and video content in the neighborhood and at organizational events when needed.
* Create and edit Reels, Stories, posts, carousels, and other social-first content.
* Help identify opportunities to showcase member businesses, events, neighborhood experiences, and community stories.
* Ensure social content remains visually consistent with the organization's overall brand and marketing strategy.

*Digital & Email Marketing*

* Design graphics and supporting creative for email marketing campaigns.
* Assist with the production and deployment of newsletters and promotional emails.
* Support updates to organizational websites and landing pages.
* Create digital assets for event pages, ticketing platforms, advertising campaigns, and partner promotions.
* Work with the Marketing Director to ensure creative is optimized for the appropriate platform and audience.

*Marketing Coordination & Special Projects*

* Work closely with the Marketing Director to execute broader marketing campaigns and initiatives.
* Translate strategic direction into polished creative deliverables.
* Implement feedback from Board members, committees, staff, and other stakeholders while maintaining the integrity of the creative concept.
* Coordinate with printers, photographers, videographers, contractors, agencies, and other creative vendors as needed.
* Support special events, neighborhood campaigns, business promotions, and other organizational initiatives.

There will be **a lot of design time.** On any given day, you might be developing the visual direction for an upcoming event, turning that concept into social and email graphics, preparing signage for print, editing a Reel, updating a webpage, or working with the Marketing Director to incorporate committee feedback into a campaign.

This is a hands-on creative role. While you'll participate in strategy and planning conversations, you'll spend much of your time actually making things.

* Strong graphic design portfolio demonstrating excellent typography, composition, hierarchy, branding, and visual storytelling.
* Strong creative point of view and understanding of contemporary design across digital, social, and print mediums.
* Experience designing for social media and digital marketing.
* Ability to take creative direction and independently execute projects from concept through final production.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Ability to navigate feedback from multiple stakeholders with professionalism, diplomacy, and good judgment.
* Strong attention to detail.

*Preferred*

From free internet access to way-finding to real-time information, our products make city life easier and more sustainable. We further enrich cities with experiential programming that inspires and engages people throughout their day. With valuable, diverse audiences in America’s top cities, we provide innovative, data-driven solutions for brands to reach urbanites at scale.

**What is the Role?**

Intersection is seeking an upbeat, energetic, and self-motivated Sales Coordinator to join the Client Success Team and work in one of our Central offices! This is a fast-paced, detail-oriented, and varied role that is perfect for someone who has experience in sales support within the media/advertising world. The ideal candidate will have outstanding interpersonal and customer service skills, have a drive to learn and the ability to perform sales support responsibilities and thrive within a team environment. Above all, this individual will provide full support to their Sales Account Executive(s), improve the sales cycles by aiding to activate new processes to ensure we live by “The Intersection Way” - maintaining a collaborative and consultative effort with our Clients.

**What you will accomplish:**

**Within your first month:**

* You will build strong relationships with your Manager, the Account Executives and Account Manager that they support
* You will onboard/train with one of the Client Success Sales Ambassadors
* You will take a deep dive into learning Intersections media and advertising offerings
* You will be a Mentee to other Sales Coordinators to learn the process and systems used within the sales support organization
* You will be exposed to all departments within Intersection and experience how they are part of the sales cycle

**Within your first three-six months:**

* You will manage all inventory requests, inventory holds, market avails, media plans / proposals for your Account Executives/Account Managers book of business
* You will generate targeting maps and visuals for RFP responses
* You will handle invoicing requests / billing inquiries

* You will be a “go-to” person who gets stuff done accurately and on time, whether it’s printing materials, setting up meetings with our clients, or building sales decks from scratch
* You will be communicating over email / by phone with internal resources (charting, ad ops, inventory, & account teams) and our Clients to ensure a smooth & positive customer service experience
* You will be a member of a great team at Intersection!

* You have a degree from an Accredited Institution

* You enjoy collaborating with people to get work done, but know when to take ownership of a task

* You have knowledge of Adobe and Microsoft Office Suite and do not mind busy work utilizing these tools for RFPs

At AmTrust, we're focused on helping businesses thrive through specialized insurance solutions, strong distribution partnerships, and a commitment to continuous innovation. As we continue to grow, marketing plays an important role in connecting customer and partner needs with the products, services, and experiences that drive business success.

The Integrated Marketing Strategy & Planning Manager serves as a key marketing partner to assigned business, product, and functional leaders. This role helps connect business goals to marketing activities that support growth, strengthen distribution relationships, and improve customer engagement.

The ideal candidate is naturally curious and enjoys learning how the business works. They ask thoughtful questions, build strong relationships, and work collaboratively across teams to help turn business priorities into actionable marketing plans.

As part of the corporate marketing organization, this role will support a defined portfolio of products and business partners, serving as a bridge between the business unit to ensure priorities are understood, projects move forward efficiently, and marketing efforts are aligned with business unit and brand objectives.

**This role follows a hybrid work schedule and requires in-office presence four days per week in our Cleveland, Chicago, Boston, or Southington office.**

  
Responsibilities:

**What You'll Do**

**Business Partnership & Planning (50%)**

* Serve as the primary marketing contact for assigned business units, building trusted relationships with leaders across product, distribution, sales, underwriting, and other functions.
* Develop a strong understanding of business objectives, market opportunities, customer needs, and growth priorities.
* Manage the intake and progression of marketing requests and opportunities, helping stakeholders understand priorities, timelines, dependencies, and available resources.
* Support business partners in translating goals and challenges into marketing recommendations and actionable plans.
* Balance competing stakeholder needs and evaluate opportunities, recommend priorities, and help allocate marketing resources toward initiatives with the greatest potential business impact.
* Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and marketing teams, ensuring priorities, requirements, and feedback are clearly communicated.
* Keep business partners informed on marketing initiatives, project status, performance, and key decisions.

**Marketing Strategy & Go-to-Market Support (30%)**

* Develop marketing briefs and recommendations that help guide campaign development and execution.
* Translate complex business, product, and underwriting concepts into clear customer, agent, and broker-focused messaging that supports marketing and go-to-market initiatives.
* Develop a working knowledge of content marketing, paid media, events, digital channels, and other marketing disciplines to effectively connect business needs with marketing solutions.
* Help ensure marketing programs are aligned with audience needs, business priorities, and desired outcomes.

**Insights & Market Understanding (10%)**

* Partner with research, analytics, and customer experience teams to better understand audience needs and behaviors.
* Gather and apply customer, market, competitor, and performance insights to support recommendations and decision-making.
* Identify trends, opportunities, and gaps that may influence marketing priorities or business performance.

**Measurement & Continuous Improvement (10%)**

* Help define success measures and support performance tracking for marketing programs and initiatives.
* Review campaign and program results to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Partner with analytics teams to understand performance trends and support optimization efforts.
* Contribute to a culture of accountability, learning, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications:

**What We're Looking For**

* 5-7 years of experience in brand marketing, product marketing, communications, account management, media strategy, market research, or related discipline.
* Experience supporting the authoring of marketing plans, campaigns, go-to-market initiatives, or business-focused marketing programs.
* Ability to build strong relationships and work effectively across multiple teams and stakeholder groups.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a natural curiosity for understanding customers, markets, and business challenges.
* Experience working with sales, distribution, product, underwriting, or other business partners is preferred.
* Comfortable using research, data, and insights to support recommendations and decision-making.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and organizational skills.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

new_jobs.description:
**Company Description**

At Northwestern Medicine, every patient interaction makes a difference in cultivating a positive workplace. This patient-first approach is what sets us apart as a leader in the healthcare industry. As an integral part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to join our quest for better health care, no matter where you work within the Northwestern Medicine system. We pride ourselves on providing competitive benefits: from tuition reimbursement and loan forgiveness to 401(k) matching and lifecycle benefits, our goal is to take care of our employees. Ready to join our quest for better?

 **Job Description**

**\*\*This is a Full Time, salaried position at 40 hours per week located at the Glenview Cardiology clinic. Schedule is Monday through Friday.\*\***

The **Operations Coordinator Physician Practice**reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

This position will report to the Practice Manager or Director and will be responsible for managing the daily operations of practice site(s), supervising clinical and administrative support personnel, coordinating provider schedules, manage practice collections, ensure service excellence and perform service recovery as necessary.

Position manages workload distribution and prioritization of tasks. Responsible for front-line communication with staff to receive and provide feedback regarding quality and productivity. Position may perform staff work in assigned areas of responsibility when not conducting coordinator function.

Responsibilities:

* Supervise and direct the office’s front-line clinical and clerical staff.
* Participate in interviewing, hiring, training, progressive discipline, dismissals, and performance appraisals.
* Oversee and direct day to day office operations within budget guidelines.
* Manage providers’ schedules with templates and optimize patient care hours to enhance productivity.
* Schedule staff and allocate resources across hours of operation to maximize patient access and satisfaction, provider productivity and efficiency, and staff productivity.
* Conduct timely and accurate cash management duties, including overseeing the collection of co-pays and patient balances, in-house cash balances, and bank deposits.
* Ensure that service excellence is delivered and perform service recovery whenever necessary.
* Manage office and medical surgical supplies within budget.
* Ensure accuracy of all data collection and data entry by site staff through training and compliance monitoring and facilitate and oversee flow of information to and from central administrative offices.
* Conduct office staff meetings on a regular basis.
* Attend and actively participate in manager/supervisor meetings.
* Ensure that patient dignity and confidentiality are maintained at all times.

*Additional Functions:*

* Review and approve automated time reports for accuracy.
* Develop tools to support staff and enhance efficiency.
* Provide input into staff performance reviews. May participate with manager in conducting staff performance reviews. Provide one to one coaching and mentoring.
* Plan, execute and resolve all routine technical needs of the practice (phone, copiers, fax machines, PCs, etc).
* Monitor daily transaction activity to ensure compliance with procedures.
* Resolve complex or critical situations involving patients, staff and customers: consults with manager for guidance as needed (e.g., complaints, discipline, etc.).
* Schedule staff and allocate resources across hours of operation to maximize patient access and satisfaction, provider productivity and efficiency, staff productivity, cost-savings, and operational efficiencies.
* Develop and implement policies and procedures as needed to support the practice.
* Complete other duties as assigned.

  
**Qualifications**

Required

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
* Minimum of three years work experience in a medical or related business.
* Comprehension of insurance plans including HMO, PPO, POS, commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid.
* Solid understanding of patient flow in a medical office.
* Leadership experience.
* Working knowledge of medical software, Word and Excel.
* Experience managing daily cash activity and reconciling income reports with daily payments.

Preferred

* Clinical experience as an MA, LPN, or RN.
* Knowledge of CPT and ICD-9 coding.
* Supervisory experience.

  
**Additional Information**

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

**Background Check**

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check. Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

**Artificial Intelligence Disclosure**

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

**Benefits**

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.
